title: Relational Abstractions for Spatial Reasoning with Diffusion Models
title_zh: 基于扩散模型的空间推理关系抽象

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models excel at image synthesis, but they remain limited in their ability to reliably satisfy structured spatial reasoning constraints. In conditional data distribution modeling tasks with implicit logical structure, such as puzzles defined by visible clues paired with consistent solutions, state-of-the-art generative models tend to approximate pixel-space distributions without learning the underlying logical rules required for inference. To address this limitation, we present a novel framework for spatial reasoning with diffusion models that leverages unsupervised object discovery and abstractions of object relations. We show that the relational knowledge derived from object-centric representations enriches diffusion models with structural primitives, allowing them to effectively guide the generative representation space during both training and inference, and enabling conditional image generation that satisfies reasoning constraints. Additionally, we introduce a large-scale generative spatial reasoning benchmark with four datasets inspired by human-solvable puzzles. Our results show that relational abstractions significantly improve reasoning capabilities of diffusion models on a variety of complex reasoning tasks, while enabling robust generalization in out-of-distribution settings 1 1 1 Code and datasets are available at: https://github.com/anaezquerro/rdm . .
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型在图像合成方面表现出色，但在可靠地满足结构化空间推理约束方面的能力仍然有限。 在具有隐式逻辑结构的条件数据分布建模任务中（例如由可见线索与一致解共同定义的谜题），当前最先进的生成模型往往仅能近似像素空间分布，而未能学习推理所需的底层逻辑规则。 为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一种基于扩散模型的空间推理新框架，该框架利用无监督对象发现以及对对象关系的抽象表示。 我们的研究表明，源自以对象为中心的表达方式的关联知识为扩散模型提供了结构化的基础元素，使其能够在训练和推理阶段有效引导生成表示空间，从而实现满足推理约束的条件图像生成。 此外，我们还引入了一项大规模生成式空间推理基准测试，包含四个受人类可解谜题启发构建的数据集。 我们的结果表明，关联抽象表示显著提升了扩散模型在各种复杂推理任务中的推理能力，并使其在分布外场景下具备更强的泛化能力 1 1 1 代码和数据集可在以下地址获取：https://github.com/anaezquerro/rdm . .

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models, including denoising-based ( Sohl-Dickstein et al., 2015 ; Ho et al., 2020 ) , score-based ( Song and Ermon, 2019 ; Song et al., 2021 ) , and flow-based formulations ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) , have emerged as powerful generative paradigms for learning and high-fidelity sampling from complex data distributions with remarkable success. Importantly, these models implicitly capture structural and semantic regularities of data, suggesting a promising foundation for reasoning in continuous domains. While reasoning in language has been extensively explored with large language models, how diffusion models can perform spatial reasoning remains an open question.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型，包括基于去噪的（Sohl-Dickstein 等人，2015；Ho 等人，2020）、基于得分的（Song 和 Ermon，2019；Song 等人，2021）以及基于流的模型（Lipman 等人，2023），已成为从复杂数据分布中学习和进行高保真采样的强大生成范式，并取得了显著成功。 重要的是，这些模型隐式地捕捉了数据的结构和语义规律，这表明它们为在连续域中进行推理提供了一个有前景的基础。 尽管大型语言模型在语言推理方面已被广泛研究，但扩散模型如何执行空间推理仍然是一个开放性问题。

paragraphs.en: Spatial reasoning requires detecting visual patterns, inducing hypotheses, and systematically applying rules to solve complex problems ( Raven, 1938 ; Fleuret et al., 2011 ) . Building on the success of deep learning on image data, prior work has explored neural approaches to Abstract Visual Reasoning, where models are trained on tasks such as Raven’s Progressive Matrices (RPM) ( Barrett et al., 2018 ) and Bongard-style problems ( Nie et al., 2020 ) . These methods traditionally frame visual reasoning as a discriminative task, requiring models to make a categorical choice rather than synthesizing a solution. This formulation has been criticized for allowing models to exploit superficial visual heuristics rather than demonstrating genuine, systematic rule inference ( Webb et al., 2021 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) . To address this limitation, recent work has shifted toward framing spatial reasoning as a generative problem. The ARC challenge ( Chollet, 2019 ) in particular, requires models to synthesize a complete output grid from scratch. However, existing approaches typically rely on symbolic program synthesis ( Chollet et al., 2024 ) , while their application to pixel-level image synthesis remains challenging. More recently, diffusion models have been explored in structured visual reasoning tasks, such as Sudoku-style image generation, with a particular focus on adapting inference-time sampling strategies to improve solution consistency ( Wewer et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) . In contrast, we argue that effective generative reasoning over complex visual domains requires moving beyond refined pixel-level reconstruction to incorporate higher-level context abstractions within the generation process.
paragraphs.zh: 空间推理需要检测视觉模式、提出假设，并系统地应用规则来解决复杂问题（Raven, 1938；Fleuret 等，2011）。 基于深度学习在图像数据上的成功，先前的研究探索了抽象视觉推理的神经方法，其中模型在诸如拉文渐进矩阵（RPM）（Barrett 等，2018）和邦加德风格问题（Nie 等，2020）等任务上进行训练。 这些方法传统上将视觉推理视为一种判别性任务，要求模型做出分类选择，而非合成解决方案。 这种设定受到批评，因为它允许模型利用表面的视觉启发式策略，而不是展示真正系统化的规则推理（Webb 等，2021；Ye 等，2025）。 为了解决这一局限性，近期的研究转向将空间推理框架化为一个生成性问题。 特别是 ARC 挑战（Chollet, 2019）要求模型从头开始合成一个完整的输出网格。 然而，现有方法通常依赖符号程序合成（Chollet 等，2024），而将其应用于像素级图像合成仍然具有挑战性。 最近，扩散模型已被探索用于结构化视觉推理任务，例如数独风格的图像生成，特别关注调整推理时的采样策略以提高解决方案的一致性（Wewer 等，2025；Lee 等，2025）。 相比之下，我们认为，在复杂视觉领域进行有效的生成性推理需要超越精细的像素级重建，在生成过程中融入更高层级的上下文抽象。

paragraphs.en: Contributions: We introduce RDM ( R elational Abstractions for D iffusion M odels ), a novel framework for spatial reasoning with diffusion models that leverages unsupervised object discovery via Slot Attention ( Locatello et al., 2020 ) and abstractions of object relations. We show that the relational knowledge derived from object-centric embeddings via Abstractors ( Mondal et al., 2024 ; Altabaa et al., 2024 ) enhances diffusion models with contextual primitives for both training and inference, enabling high-fidelity image synthesis while adhering to the reasoning constraints. We introduce a large-scale benchmark consisting of four new challenging datasets inspired by popular human-solvable puzzles for studying spatial reasoning as a conditional generative modeling task, where underlying logical rules must be inferred from training data. Each dataset contains up to one million paired examples, covering grid-based image completion and multi-context image generation tasks across multiple levels of abstraction. Our approach improves performance on a variety of complex reasoning tasks, by up to 3 × \times on the challenging multi-context reasoning problems, while demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization.
paragraphs.zh: 贡献：我们提出了 RDM（R elational Abstractions for D iffusion M odels），这是一种用于扩散模型空间推理的新框架，它通过 Slot Attention（Locatello 等人，2020）实现无监督对象发现，并利用对象关系的抽象表示。 我们发现，通过 Abstractors（Mondal 等人，2024；Altabaa 等人，2024）从以对象为中心的嵌入中获得的关联知识，为扩散模型提供了训练和推理所需的上下文基础元素，从而能够在遵循推理约束的同时生成高保真图像。 我们引入了一项大规模基准测试，包含四个受人类可解谜题启发而设计的新挑战数据集，用于将空间推理研究为一种条件生成建模任务，其中必须从训练数据中推断出底层的逻辑规则。 每个数据集最多包含一百万对示例，涵盖了网格化图像补全和多上下文图像生成任务，并覆盖了多个抽象层次。 我们的方法在各种复杂推理任务上的性能均有提升，在具有挑战性的多上下文推理问题上性能提升高达 3 × \times，同时展现出强大的分布外泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Spatial reasoning with generative models: Several works explore generative models for visual reasoning. In RPM, this requires synthesizing a missing panel from scratch, requiring complete understanding of the underlying relational rules. Earlier solutions primarily used deep latent variable models ( Pekar et al., 2020 ) with structured latent spaces ( Shi et al., 2024 ) , to abstract explicit rules on concepts. However, these solvers often require handcrafted inductive biases rooted in RPM-specific rules to facilitate abstraction and panel generation. More recently, diffusion models have been explored for spatial reasoning with sampling-time solutions ( Wewer et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) . Notably, Wewer et al. (2025) proposed SRM based on diffusion forcing ( Chen et al., 2024a ) , to perform spatial reasoning as conditional image generation. It proposes an incremental sampling strategy based on patch-level uncertainty estimation, exploiting the grid structure of Sudoku-style tasks with state-of-the-art performance, but is inherently tailored to structured grids.
paragraphs.zh: 生成模型的空间推理：多项研究探索了用于视觉推理的生成模型。 在 RPM 中，这要求从头合成缺失的面板，从而需要对底层的关联规则有完全的理解。 早期的解决方案主要使用深度潜在变量模型（Pekar 等人，2020）和结构化潜在空间（Shi 等人，2024），以抽象概念上的显式规则。 然而，这些求解器通常需要基于 RPM 特定规则的手工设计的归纳偏置，以促进抽象和面板生成。 近期，研究人员开始探索将扩散模型用于空间推理的采样时解决方案（Wewer 等人，2025；Lee 等人，2025）。值得注意的是，Wewer 等人 （2025）提出了基于扩散强制（Chen 等人，2024a）的 SRM，将空间推理视为条件图像生成问题。 该方法提出了一种基于块级不确定性估计的增量采样策略，利用数独类任务的网格结构实现了当前最优的性能，但其本质上是为结构化网格量身定制的。

paragraphs.en: Object discovery: Object discovery is rooted in the hypothesis that human intelligence decomposes complex visual scenes into discrete, interacting entities ( Battaglia et al., 2018 ; Greff et al., 2019 ) , and studies aim to instill a similar inductive bias into neural networks by moving beyond dense feature maps to interpretable object representations. Locatello et al. (2020) aligned this concept into modern neural networks via Slot Attention , a framework that disentangles the feature and positional information of visual components into high-dimensional embeddings, named slots , representing the objects captured in the scene. Object discovery has been also adopted for discriminative reasoning tasks, where relational modules aggregate information across disentangled slots to model object interactions. Methods such as CoRelNet ( Kerg et al., 2022 ) , OCRA ( Webb et al., 2023 ) and Abstractors ( Altabaa et al., 2024 ) leverage object-centric designs in which learned relations condition a classification head, exploiting the ability of slots to disentangle scene factors under discriminative objectives. Recent object-centric diffusion models ( Wu et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2023 ) extend these to generative settings, with a focus on downstream vision tasks and compositional image synthesis capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 物体发现：物体发现的理论基础在于这样一个假设，即人类智能会将复杂的视觉场景分解为相互作用的独立实体（Battaglia 等人，2018；Greff 等人，2019）。相关研究旨在通过超越密集特征图、转向可解释的物体表示，将类似的归纳偏置注入神经网络。Locatello 等人 （2020）通过“槽位注意力”（Slot Attention）将这一概念整合到现代神经网络中。该框架将视觉组件的特征信息与位置信息解耦为高维嵌入（称为“槽位”），用以表示场景中捕捉到的物体。 物体发现也被应用于判别性推理任务，其中关系模块会聚合来自解耦槽位的信息，以建模物体间的相互作用。 CoRelNet（Kerg 等人，2022）、OCRA（Webb 等人，2023）和 Abstractors（Altabaa 等人，2024）等方法采用了以物体为中心的设计：学习到的关系会条件化分类头，利用槽位在判别性目标下解耦场景因素的能力。 近期的以物体为中心的扩散模型（Wu 等人，2023；Jiang 等人，2023）将这些方法扩展到了生成领域，重点关注下游视觉任务以及图像的组合式合成能力。

paragraphs.en: We formalize the spatial reasoning task as modeling the conditional distribution q ⁡ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c ) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c}) , where 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c} denotes a provided problem clue, and 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} represents a valid solution satisfying all logical constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将空间推理任务形式化为对条件分布 q ⁡ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c ) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c}) 的建模，其中 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c} 表示给定的问题线索，而 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} 代表满足所有逻辑约束的有效解。

paragraphs.en: Our proposed framework comprises two models. Our first model, the discoverer , is a latent variable model p ϕ p_{\phi} designed to capture the objects present in the samples from q ⁡ ( 𝐱 ′ ) q(\mathbf{x}^{\prime}) , where 𝐱 ′ ∈ { 𝐱 0 , 𝐱 c } \mathbf{x}^{\prime}\in\{\mathbf{x}_{0},\mathbf{x}_{c}\} , via disentangled latent representations 𝐳 ′ \mathbf{z}^{\prime} . Our second model, the reasoner , is a diffusion model p θ p_{\theta} that learns to reverse the trajectory from a Gaussian prior to the target distribution q ⁡ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c ) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c}) , conditioned on the latents 𝐳 ′ \mathbf{z}^{\prime} provided by the discoverer. The integration of object-centric latent variables 𝐳 ′ \mathbf{z}^{\prime} is motivated by the inherent difficulty of learning q ⁡ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c ) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c}) through a simple parameterization of p θ p_{\theta} . We propose to enrich the generative modeling process with relational abstractions inferred from object-centric representations obtained via an unsupervised object discovery model p ϕ ​ ( 𝐳 ′ | 𝐱 ′ ) p_{\phi}(\mathbf{z}^{\prime}|\mathbf{x}^{\prime}) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出的框架包含两个模型。 我们的第一个模型是“发现者”，它是一个潜在变量模型 p ϕ p_{\phi}，旨在通过解耦的潜在表示 𝐳 ′ \mathbf{z}^{\prime} 捕捉来自 q ⁡ ( 𝐱 ′ ) q(\mathbf{x}^{\prime}) 的样本中存在的对象，其中 𝐱 ′ ∈ { 𝐱 0 , 𝐱 c } \mathbf{x}^{\prime}\in\{\mathbf{x}_{0},\mathbf{x}_{c}\}。 我们的第二个模型是“推理者”，它是一个扩散模型 p θ p_{\theta}，能够学习从高斯先验分布逆向推演至目标分布 q ⁡ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c ) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c})，其过程以“发现者”提供的潜在变量 𝐳 ′ \mathbf{z}^{\prime} 为条件。 将面向对象的潜在变量 𝐳 ′ \mathbf{z}^{\prime} 整合进来，是因为通过简单的 p θ p_{\theta} 参数化方式学习 q ⁡ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c ) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c}) 存在固有的困难。 我们提出通过一个无监督对象发现模型 p ϕ ​ ( 𝐳 ′ | 𝐱 ′ ) p_{\phi}(\mathbf{z}^{\prime}|\mathbf{x}^{\prime}) 获得的面向对象的表示来推断关系抽象，从而丰富生成建模过程。

paragraphs.en: The objective of the discoverer is to extract informative latent representations 𝐳 ′ \mathbf{z}^{\prime} via the encoding p ϕ ​ ( 𝐳 ′ | 𝐱 ′ ) p_{\phi}(\mathbf{z}^{\prime}|\mathbf{x}^{\prime}) of a latent variable model, while simultaneously disentangling the constituent objects within 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} and 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c} . We use slot attention ( Locatello et al., 2020 ) to achieve this, which enables unsupervised learning of disentangled object embeddings from visual data via a slot-based autoencoder.
paragraphs.zh: 发现者的目标是通过潜在变量模型的编码 p ϕ ​ ( 𝐳 ′ | 𝐱 ′ ) p_{\phi}(\mathbf{z}^{\prime}|\mathbf{x}^{\prime}) 提取信息丰富的潜在表示 𝐳 ′ \mathbf{z}^{\prime}，同时分离 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} 和 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c} 中的组成对象。 我们使用槽注意力机制（Locatello 等人，2020）来实现这一目标，该机制通过基于槽的自编码器，能够从视觉数据中无监督地学习解耦的对象嵌入。

paragraphs.en: Slot attention: The slot encoder maps input visual features into a shared latent space, where k k trainable vectors (the slots ) compete to explain parts of the input via an iterative attention process. These k k slots are then passed to a spatial broadcast decoder to reconstruct the input 𝐱 ′ \mathbf{x}^{\prime} . By enforcing this reconstruction bottleneck, the model learns to partition the scene into k k distinct, permutation-invariant latent variables that capture the essential objects for the downstream reasoning task.
paragraphs.zh: 槽位注意力机制：槽位编码器将输入的视觉特征映射到一个共享的潜在空间，其中 k 个可训练的向量（即槽位）通过迭代注意力过程相互竞争，以解释输入的不同部分。 随后，这 k 个槽位被传入一个空间广播解码器，以重构输入 𝐱 ′ \mathbf{x}^{\prime}。 通过施加这种重构瓶颈，模型能够学会将场景划分为 k 个独立的、对排列不变的潜在变量，这些变量捕捉了下游推理任务所需的关键对象。

The slot encoder ℰ : ℝ H × W × c → ( ℝ m × d , ℝ m × d ) \mathcal{E}:\mathbb{R}^{\texttt{H}\times\texttt{W}\times\texttt{c}}\to(\mathbb{R}^{m\times d},\mathbb{R}^{m\times d}) is a feature extractor that yields m m features ( 𝐟 1 : m \mathbf{f}_{1:m} ) and positional embeddings ( 𝐩 1 : m \mathbf{p}_{1:m} ) in a d d -dimensional latent space. The slot attention module 𝒮 : ( ℝ m × d , ℝ m × d ) → ℝ k × d \mathcal{S}:(\mathbb{R}^{m\times d},\mathbb{R}^{m\times d})\to\mathbb{R}^{k\times d} learns to iteratively update k k randomly initialized slots 𝐬 1 : k \mathbf{s}_{1:k} , using η \eta recurrent cross-attention iterations over 𝐟 1 : m \mathbf{f}_{1:m} and 𝐩 1 : m \mathbf{p}_{1:m} to bind object-centric information to the slots. paragraphs.en: Scaling the number of slots: One of the main limitations of the original slot decoder is the computational overhead of the latent bottleneck when k k increases. Previous works have typically restricted k ≤ 10 k\leq 10 due to the memory overhead of performing independent high-resolution convolutions and subsequent weighted averaging for every slot ( Singh et al., 2022a ; Singh et al., 2022b ; Mondal et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 扩展槽位数量：原始槽位解码器的主要限制之一，是当 k 增加时潜在瓶颈所带来的计算开销。 由于对每个槽位执行独立的高分辨率卷积并随后进行加权平均会产生较大的内存开销，以往的研究通常将 k 限制在 ≤ 10（Singh et al., 2022a；Singh et al., 2022b；Mondal et al., 2023）。

paragraphs.en: To scale our discoverer to a large number of slots, we introduce the scalable slot decoder in Algorithm 1 that significantly reduces the memory demand during the backward pass. It relies on an additional learnable positional grid 𝐠 \mathbf{g} that activates specific slots with specific locations in the bottleneck of the model. Rather than decoding each slot into a full-resolution image before weighting, our scalable decoder first estimates which slots are relevant to specific locations by computing the dot product between the positional grid 𝐠 \mathbf{g} and the slot embeddings 𝐬 1 : k \mathbf{s}_{1:k} , yielding 𝜶 ~ \tilde{\boldsymbol{\alpha}} after softmax normalization. Subsequently, the slot information is weighted by 𝜶 ~ \tilde{\boldsymbol{\alpha}} and projected onto the grid, producing a single feature map 𝐬 ~ \tilde{\mathbf{s}} , where slot information is isolated on specific positions of the grid. This aggregated representation is then passed through the remaining decoder layers to generate a unified reconstruction of the input image. Effectively, introducing this learnable positional grid creates a computationally more efficient bottleneck during optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 为了将我们的发现器扩展到大量槽位，我们在算法 1 中引入了可扩展的槽位解码器，该解码器能显著降低反向传播过程中的内存需求。 它依赖一个额外的可学习位置网格 𝐠 \mathbf{g}，该网格在模型瓶颈处激活具有特定位置的具体槽位。 与在加权前将每个槽位解码为全分辨率图像不同，我们的可扩展解码器首先通过计算位置网格 𝐠 \mathbf{g} 与槽位嵌入 𝐬 1 : k \mathbf{s}_{1:k} 之间的点积，来估计哪些槽位与特定位置相关，经 softmax 归一化后得到 𝜶 ~ \tilde{\boldsymbol{\alpha}}。 随后，槽位信息会按 𝜶 ~ \tilde{\boldsymbol{\alpha}} 进行加权并投影到网格上，生成一个单一的特征图 𝐬 ~ \tilde{\mathbf{s}}，其中槽位信息被隔离在网格的特定位置。 然后，这个聚合后的表示会被传入剩余的解码器层，以生成输入图像的统一重建结果。 实际上，引入这个可学习的位置网格在优化过程中创建了一个计算效率更高的瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: The reasoner is a diffusion model conditioned on the clue 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c} and the embeddings 𝐳 ′ = ( 𝐟 ~ 1 : k ′ ; 𝐩 ~ 1 : k ′ ) \mathbf{z}^{\prime}=(\tilde{\mathbf{f}}_{1:k}^{\prime};\tilde{\mathbf{p}}_{1:k}^{\prime}) obtained by the discoverer, where ′ ∈ { 0 , c } \prime\in\{0,c\} . We formalize generative modeling of q ⁡ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c ) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c}) through a diffusion guidance framework ( Ho and Salimans, 2021 ) based on embeddings learned by a relational abstraction module ( ℛ \mathcal{R} ). We use a single parameterization of p θ p_{\theta} to learn both the solution-guided distribution p θ ​ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c , ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 c , 𝐳 0 ) ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c},\mathbf{z}^{0})) , and unguided distribution p θ ​ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c , ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 c ) ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c})) . This resembles the training setup of classifier-free guidance (CFG). Unlike CFG, however, RDM does not combine the guided and unguided distributions for sampling, since the solution is unavailable at inference time.
paragraphs.zh: 推理器是一个扩散模型，其条件依赖于线索 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c} 以及发现器获得的嵌入向量 𝐳 ′ = ( 𝐟 ~ 1 : k ′ ; 𝐩 ~ 1 : k ′ ) \mathbf{z}^{\prime}=(\tilde{\mathbf{f}}_{1:k}^{\prime};\tilde{\mathbf{p}}_{1:k}^{\prime})，其中 ′ ∈ { 0 , c } \prime\in\{0,c\}。 我们通过一个基于关系抽象模块（ℛ \mathcal{R}）所学习嵌入向量的扩散引导框架（Ho and Salimans, 2021），对 q ⁡ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c ) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c}) 的生成建模进行形式化。 我们使用单一参数化 p θ p_{\theta} 来同时学习由解决方案引导的分布 p θ ​ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c , ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 c , 𝐳 0 ) ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c},\mathbf{z}^{0})) 和无引导的分布 p θ ​ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c , ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 c ) ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c}))。 这与无分类器引导（CFG）的训练设置相似。 然而，与 CFG 不同，RDM 在采样时不会将引导分布和无引导分布结合使用，因为在推理阶段解决方案并不可用。

paragraphs.en: Relational abstraction: This module ℛ : ( ℝ K × d , ℝ K × d ) → ℝ K × d \smash{\mathcal{R}:(\mathbb{R}^{K\times d},\mathbb{R}^{K\times d})\to\mathbb{R}^{K\times d}} processes the latents ( 𝐟 ~ 1 : k ∗ , 𝐩 ~ 1 : k ∗ ) \smash{(\tilde{\mathbf{f}}_{1:k}^{*},\tilde{\mathbf{p}}^{*}_{1:k})} with Slot Abstractors ( Mondal et al., 2024 ) , where ∗ = ( c , 0 ) *=(c,0) and K ≥ 2 ​ k K\geq 2k varies with the number of clues and solutions. It consists of interleaved cross-attention, self-attention and feed-forward blocks with residual connections, designed to hierarchically capture inter-slot semantics and positional relations by sequentially refining the positional signal ( 𝐩 ~ ∗ 1 : k \smash{\tilde{\mathbf{p}}^{*}_{1:k}} ) with query-key feature projections ( 𝐟 ~ ∗ 1 : k \smash{\tilde{\mathbf{f}}^{*}_{1:k}} ) into relational embeddings 𝐫 ∗ 1 : k \mathbf{r}^{*}_{1:k} (see § B.2 for details). After L L abstractor blocks, this module returns 𝐫 1 : k ∗ = ℛ ( 𝐟 ~ 1 : k ∗ , 𝐩 ~ 1 : k ∗ ) \smash{\mathbf{r}^{*}_{1:k}=\mathcal{R}(\tilde{\mathbf{f}}_{1:k}^{*},\tilde{\mathbf{p}}^{*}_{1:k})} , encoding object relations. This ensures that the generative process will be guided not only by individual object features, but also by their contextual interactions.

paragraphs.en: Conditional generative modeling: During training, the disentangled representations of the solution ( 𝐳 0 \mathbf{z}^{0} ) are nullified with probability p drop p_{\text{drop}} to simulate the unguided distribution p θ ​ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c , ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 c ) ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c})) used at inference; and maintained with probability ( 1 − p drop ) (1-p_{\text{drop}}) to learn the solution-guided distribution p θ ​ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c , ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 c , 𝐳 0 ) ) \smash{p_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c},\mathbf{z}^{0}))} . By modeling both distributions with a single parameterization p θ p_{\theta} , the reasoner learns: (1) the relations between the disentangled factors of the clue and the solution ( 𝐫 ∗ 1 : k \mathbf{r}^{*}_{1:k} ) and (2) to generate the solution 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} at inference-time by relying only on the clue information ( 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c} , 𝐳 c \mathbf{z}^{c} ). Training can be either based on noise prediction ( Ho et al., 2020 ) , score matching ( Song et al., 2021 ) , or flow matching ( Lipman et al., 2023 ) (which we use in our experiments, see § B.3 for details).
paragraphs.zh: 条件生成建模：在训练期间，以概率 p drop p_{\text{drop}} 将解的解耦表示（ 𝐳 0 \mathbf{z}^{0} ）置零，以模拟推理时使用的无引导分布 p θ ​ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c , ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 c ) ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c}))；并以概率 ( 1 − p drop ) (1-p_{\text{drop}}) 保留该表示，以学习由解引导的分布 p θ ​ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c , ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 c , 𝐳 0 ) ) \smash{p_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c},\mathbf{z}^{0}))}。 通过用单一参数化 p θ p_{\theta} 对两种分布进行建模，推理器能够学习：(1) 线索的解耦因子与解之间的关联（ 𝐫 ∗ 1 : k \mathbf{r}^{*}_{1:k} ），以及 (2) 在推理时仅依赖线索信息（ 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c} , 𝐳 c \mathbf{z}^{c} ）生成解 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0}。 训练可以基于噪声预测（ Ho et al., 2020 ）、得分匹配（ Song et al., 2021 ），或流匹配（ Lipman et al., 2023 ）（我们在实验中使用了该方法，详见 § B.3）。

paragraphs.en: We present a novel benchmark comprising four datasets with up to one million images each, inspired by classic logic puzzles, where underlying logical rules are implicit in the conditional data distribution and must be inferred from training data. We categorize them into two paradigms: (i) grid-based image completion tasks: Akari and Coldoku , where reasoning is framed as inpainting under global and local spatial constraints, and (ii) multi-context image generation : Tangram and LogicFace , where a latent rule must be inferred from context images to synthesize a consistent solution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种新的基准测试，包含四个数据集，每个数据集最多含有一百万张图像。该基准测试的灵感源自经典逻辑谜题，其中潜在的逻辑规则隐含在条件数据分布中，必须通过训练数据进行推断。 我们将这些任务分为两种范式：（i）基于网格的图像补全任务：Akari 和 Coldoku，其中推理被框架为在全局和局部空间约束下的图像修复；以及（ii）多语境图像生成：Tangram 和 LogicFace，其中必须从语境图像中推断出潜在规则，以合成一致的解决方案。

sents.zh: 目标是用数字 1 到 9 填充网格，使得每一列、每一行和每个子网格中都不包含重复的数字。

sents.en: The puzzle setter provides a partially completed grid as the clue , from which a well-posed solution can be derived.
sents.zh: 谜题出题人会提供一个部分完成的网格作为提示，由此可以推导出一个合理的解。

paragraphs.en: variants of this task for generative modeling. We extend this in Coldoku , a colored variant of this puzzle, where we again have a 9 × 9 9\times 9 grid satisfying the Sudoku rules (Figure 3a ), and add an extra layer of complexity by coloring the digits such that there are no repeated colors in each row, column and subgrid (Figures 3b ). Coldoku requires solving two different Sudokus simultaneously, one considering the digits and the other considering colors. More details can be found in § A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 该任务的生成式建模变体。 我们在 Coldoku 中对此进行了扩展，这是一种带颜色的谜题变体。其中，我们仍然使用一个满足数独规则的 9×9 网格（图 3a），并通过为数字上色来增加一层复杂性，确保每行、每列和每个子网格中都没有重复的颜色（图 3b）。 Coldoku 需要同时解决两个不同的数独：一个关注数字，另一个关注颜色。 更多细节请参见 § A.2。

paragraphs.en: Tangram dataset: Tangram is a dissection puzzle consisting of seven flat shapes ( tans ): a square ( □ \square ), a parallelogram ( ), two small triangles ( △ S × 2 \triangle^{S}\times 2 ), a medium triangle ( △ M \triangle^{M} ) and two large triangles ( △ L × 2 \triangle^{L}\times 2 ), which can be arranged to form figures without overlapping.
paragraphs.zh: Tangram 数据集：Tangram 是一种分割谜题，由七种平面图形（tans）组成：一个正方形（□ \square）、一个平行四边形（）、两个小三角形（△ S × 2 \triangle^{S}\times 2）、一个中等大小的三角形（△ M \triangle^{M}）和两个大三角形（△ L × 2 \triangle^{L}\times 2），这些图形可以组合成各种形状，且不会重叠。

paragraphs.en: The goal is to assemble all the pieces to match a given silhouette , such that no piece overlaps with other, and all pieces of the puzzle are used (Figure 4 ). Tangram requires reasoning over shapes, sizes, rotations and displacements of the pieces to project the final solution, reflecting forms of geometric reasoning studied in humans ( Bohning and Althouse, 1997 ; Wong et al., 2019 ) . We rely on the Kilogram dataset ( Ji et al., 2022 ) consisting of 1,013 uncolored Tangram solutions, and introduce the vision task of generating a valid solution (Figure 4c ) by using an input pattern (Figure 4b ) and a set of colored tans (Figure 4a ). We generate different tan views and solutions by rotating the puzzle and randomly assigning distinct colors to tans (see § A.3 for details, as well as a discussion on Tangram task complexity in § C.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 目标是将所有拼图块组合起来，使其与给定的轮廓相匹配，同时确保没有任何一块与其他块重叠，并且所有拼图块都被使用（图4）。 七巧板需要对拼图块的形状、大小、旋转和位移进行推理，以推导出最终解法，这反映了人类所研究的几何推理形式（Bohning 和 Althouse，1997；Wong 等，2019）。 我们依赖 Kilogram 数据集（Ji 等，2022），该数据集包含 1,013 个未上色的七巧板解法，并引入了一项视觉任务：通过输入图案（图4b）和一组带颜色的“tan”块（图4a）生成有效的解法（图4c）。 我们通过旋转拼图并随机为“tan”块分配不同颜色来生成不同的“tan”视图和解法（详见 § A.3，以及关于七巧板任务复杂性的讨论见 § C.2）。

paragraphs.en: LogicFace ( Logical Operators on Facial Features ) dataset: We present a challenging logic-based generative modeling problem that requires abstraction and reasoning over real images. Specifically, LogicFace defines a conditional generative modeling task for human faces, where certain facial features are combined through hidden logical operators that must be inferred from training examples.
paragraphs.zh: LogicFace（面部特征的逻辑算子）数据集：我们提出了一个具有挑战性的基于逻辑的生成建模问题，该问题需要对真实图像进行抽象和推理。 具体来说，LogicFace 定义了一项针对人脸的条件生成建模任务，其中某些面部特征通过隐藏的逻辑算子组合在一起，而这些逻辑算子必须从训练示例中推断出来。

sents.en: LogicFace ( Logical Operators on Facial Features ) dataset: We present a challenging logic-based generative modeling problem that requires abstraction and reasoning over real images.

paragraphs.en: Model configurations: For the discoverer, we use a convolutional autoencoder where the number of slots ( k k ), slot dimension ( d d ) and bottleneck resolution ( h , w ) (\texttt{h},\texttt{w}) are adapted to the specific task (see Table 3 ). The slot encoder maps the input into m m feature and positional embeddings. Slot attention performs η = 3 \eta=3 recurrent iterations and feeds k k slots to the decoder. For Tangram and LogicFace we chose k = 7 k=7 and k = 6 k=6 , respectively. For Coldoku and Akari , where the true number of objects scales with the number of cells, i.e., 81 and 121 respectively, we propose two configurations: one where k k coincides with the number of cells, hence requiring reconstruction with our scalable slot decoder (Algorithm 1 ), and the other with k = 16 k=16 , such that each slot integrates information from multiple cells. For experiments with k ∈ { 6 , 7 , 16 } k\in\{6,7,16\} we use the original slot decoder ( Locatello et al., 2020 ) . For the reasoner, we use a U-Net architecture with an attention-based bottleneck, where relational embeddings learned in L = 6 L=6 abstractor layers are incorporated via cross-attention ( Chen et al., 2024b ) . To study the impact of model size, we conduct experiments with small ( S ), medium ( M ) and large ( L ) backbone U-Net architectures. Further architectural details are explained in § B .
paragraphs.zh: 模型配置：对于发现者，我们使用一种卷积自编码器，其中槽位数量（k）、槽位维度（d）和瓶颈分辨率（h, w）（\texttt{h},\texttt{w}）会根据具体任务进行调整（参见表3）。 槽位编码器将输入映射为m个特征嵌入和位置嵌入。 槽位注意力执行η = 3次循环迭代，并将k个槽位输入解码器。 对于Tangram和LogicFace，我们分别选择了k = 7和k = 6。 对于Coldoku和Akari，其中真实物体数量与单元格数量成比例（分别为81和121），我们提出了两种配置：一种是将槽位数量k与单元格数量一致，因此需要使用我们可扩展的槽位解码器（算法1）进行重建；另一种是设置k = 16，使每个槽位整合来自多个单元格的信息。 对于k ∈ {6, 7, 16}的实验，我们使用原始的槽位解码器（Locatello等，2020）。 对于推理者，我们使用一种带有注意力机制瓶颈的U-Net架构，其中在L = 6个抽象层中学到的关系嵌入通过交叉注意力被整合进来（Chen等，2024b）。 为了研究模型规模的影响，我们使用小型（S）、中型（M）和大型（L）的骨干U-Net架构进行了实验。 更多架构细节在§ B中进行了说明。

paragraphs.en: Conditioning on relational abstractions: Our framework can guide diffusion models via abstraction and conditioning on information from two types of inputs during training: the clue (via 𝐳 c \mathbf{z}^{c} ) and the solution (via 𝐳 0 \smash{\mathbf{z}^{0}} ). During training, we drop the condition 𝐳 0 \smash{\mathbf{z}^{0}} with probability p drop = 0.5 \smash{p_{\text{drop}}=0.5} 2 2 2 We observed that smaller p drop \smash{p_{\text{drop}}} values degrade estimation of the unconditional distribution of interest at inference time, although recommended in previous works ( Ho and Salimans, 2021 ) . We found the best balance at p drop = 0.5 \smash{p_{\text{drop}}=0.5} , hypothesizing that it allows to evenly learn both the solution-guided and unguided distributions. to disable the conditioning derived from the solution, since 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} will not be available at inference time.
paragraphs.zh: 基于关系抽象的条件设定：我们的框架可以通过抽象机制，在训练过程中利用两类输入信息对扩散模型进行引导和条件设定：线索（通过 𝐳 c \mathbf{z}^{c} ）和解决方案（通过 𝐳 0 \smash{\mathbf{z}^{0}} ）。 在训练期间，我们以概率 p drop = 0.5 \smash{p_{\text{drop}}=0.5} 移除对 𝐳 0 \smash{\mathbf{z}^{0}} 的条件约束。我们发现较小的 p drop \smash{p_{\text{drop}}} 值会损害推理阶段对目标无条件分布的估计效果，尽管先前的研究（Ho and Salimans, 2021）推荐了这种做法。 我们发现当 p drop = 0.5 \smash{p_{\text{drop}}=0.5} 时能达到最佳平衡，推测这是因为该设置能够均衡地学习由解决方案引导的分布和无引导的分布。此时会禁用从解决方案中推导出的条件约束，因为在推理阶段 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} 将不可用。

paragraphs.en: We explore three different conditioning settings (alongside 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c} ), where relational embeddings are injected via cross-attention in the denoiser bottleneck: (i) clue : conditioning on ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 c ) \mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c}) during training and inference, (ii) solution : ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 0 ) \mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{0}) guides training and is dropped with p drop p_{\text{drop}} , and inference is unconditioned on any relational embedding, and (iii) full : both 𝐳 c \mathbf{z}^{c} and 𝐳 0 \smash{\mathbf{z}^{0}} (dropped with p drop p_{\text{drop}} ) are used during training, and only 𝐳 c \mathbf{z}^{c} is used at inference time.
paragraphs.zh: 我们探索了三种不同的条件设置（以及 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c} ），在这些设置中，关系嵌入通过去噪器的瓶颈处的交叉注意力注入：(i) clue：在训练和推理阶段都以 ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 c ) \mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c}) 为条件；(ii) solution：ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 0 ) \mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{0}) 指导训练，并以概率 p drop p_{\text{drop}} 被丢弃，而推理阶段则不对任何关系嵌入施加条件；以及 (iii) full：在训练阶段同时使用 𝐳 c \mathbf{z}^{c} 和 𝐳 0 \smash{\mathbf{z}^{0}}（后者以概率 p drop p_{\text{drop}} 被丢弃），而在推理阶段仅使用 𝐳 c \mathbf{z}^{c}。

paragraphs.en: Training details: We pretrained the slot autoencoder independently for each task based on a simple reconstruction loss (§ B.1 ), providing images of clues and solutions as training samples. We assess the quality of the reconstruction and thus the slot embeddings on a validation set (see § C for the final results and disentanglement visualizations). For the reasoner, we use flow matching to create the diffusion trajectory as detailed in § B.3 , where the mean and variance change linearly with t t . We perform deterministic sampling from the conditional distribution by solving the reverse-time ODE using τ \tau discretization steps. All generative models were trained with the same optimization settings.
paragraphs.zh: 训练细节：我们基于简单的重构损失（§ B.1），为每个任务独立预训练了槽位自编码器，并使用提示和解决方案的图像作为训练样本。 我们在验证集上评估重构的质量，进而评估槽位嵌入（最终结果和解耦可视化请参见 § C）。 对于推理器，我们使用流匹配方法生成扩散轨迹，具体细节见 § B.3，其中均值和方差随 t 线性变化。 我们通过以 τ 离散化步长求解反向时间 ODE，从条件分布中进行确定性采样。 所有生成模型均使用相同的优化设置进行训练。

sents.en: Training details: We pretrained the slot autoencoder independently for each task based on a simple reconstruction loss (§ B.1 ), providing images of clues and solutions as training samples.

paragraphs.en: Baseline comparisons: We use a capacity-matched U-Net as baseline (Base) by augmenting the hidden dimensions to match the same model size as RDM, accommodating for the additional parameters of the Discoverer and the Abstractor stack. The Base model is trained to estimate q ⁡ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c ) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c}) also via flow matching, with the main difference of not incorporating relational abstractions. We also trained this architecture with diffusion forcing ( Chen et al., 2024a ) for comparisons to SRM ( Wewer et al., 2025 ) with parallel and sequential sampling strategies, where the latter additionally requires learning uncertainty at training time to perform patch-based autoregressive denoising. We also performed experiments on MNIST-Sudoku and Counting Polygons benchmarks for completeness ( Wewer et al., 2025 ) , and ablations with non-object-centric feature guidance (details and results in § C.2.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 基线对比：我们通过扩展隐藏维度，使模型规模与 RDM 相同，并考虑 Discoverer 和 Abstractor 堆栈的额外参数，从而使用一个容量匹配的 U-Net 作为基线（Base）。 Base 模型通过流匹配训练以估计 q⁡(𝐱₀|𝐱c) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c})，主要区别在于未引入关系抽象。 我们还使用扩散强制法（Chen et al., 2024a）对该架构进行了训练，以便与采用并行和序列采样策略的 SRM（Wewer et al., 2025）进行比较；其中后者在训练时还需要学习不确定性，以实现基于图像块的自回归降噪。 为求完整，我们还对 MNIST-Sudoku 和 Counting Polygons 基准进行了实验（Wewer et al., 2025），并开展了非对象中心特征引导的消融研究（细节与结果见 § C.2.1）。

paragraphs.en: Model evaluations: We designed task-specific neural evaluators (see § A for details), and used 5,000 held-out samples per task that served as test sets. We use the overall accuracy ( acc ) as the main metric in all datasets. For Coldoku , we also report individual digit ( dgt ) and color ( clr ) accuracies across three difficulty levels: Easy (50-60 clues), Medium (40-50 clues) and Hard (30-40 clues). For Akari , we also measure the bulb accuracy ( blb ), which only evaluates the correctness of bulb allocations by ignoring the numbered walls, and evaluate both in an in-distribution (ID) regime where the wall density ratio matches the training set, and out-of-distribution (OoD) regimes with extreme wall densities: low (5-10%) and high (35-40%). For Tangram , we measure shape accuracy, which only measures the correct partition of the silhouette, and the f 1 -score per tan type. For LogicFace , we measure accuracy at feature level (proportion of correctly generated attributes). We report all results with τ = 100 \tau=100 unless specified otherwise (see § C for τ = 10 \tau=10 and varying model sizes).
paragraphs.zh: 模型评估：我们设计了针对特定任务的神经评估器（详见 § A），并为每个任务使用了 5,000 个预留样本作为测试集。 在所有数据集中，我们都将总体准确率（acc）作为主要指标。 对于 Coldoku，我们还报告了三个难度级别下各个数字（dgt）和颜色（clr）的准确率：简单级（50-60 条线索）、中等级（40-50 条线索）和困难级（30-40 条线索）。 对于 Akari，我们还测量了灯泡准确率（blb），该指标通过忽略编号墙壁来仅评估灯泡分配的正确性，并在两种情况下进行评估：在分布内（ID）场景下，墙壁密度比与训练集匹配；以及在分布外（OoD）场景下，墙壁密度分别为极低（5-10%）和极高（35-40%）。 对于 Tangram，我们测量了形状准确率，该指标仅衡量轮廓的正确分割，以及每种 tan 类型的 f1 分数。 对于 LogicFace，我们在特征层面测量准确率（正确生成的属性比例）。 除非另有说明，否则我们报告的所有结果均使用 τ = 100 \tau=100（关于 τ = 10 \tau=10 和不同模型规模的说明见 § C）。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate the performance of our models on the proposed benchmark in Tables 1 and 2 , where RDM outperforms the baselines in Akari , Tangram and LogicFace , while only lagging behind SRM in the hardest level of Coldoku . We present extended results and output examples in § C .

paragraphs.en: Results on Akari : RDM consistently outperforms baseline models across all distribution regimes and demonstrates superior generalization capabilities under the most challenging ( low ) regime. Under the in-distribution (ID) evaluation, RDM achieves 83.12 accuracy with 121 slots, compared to 80.04 for standard diffusion. We observe a performance margin between 16 and 121 slots ( clue : 83.12 vs 82.06), potentially because the slot count allows the discoverer to freely learn a bijective mapping between slots and cells, enhancing the reasoner to better exploit bulb placement. In the high regime, all models benefit from an increased wall ratio, which bounds the solution space, localizes constraints, and reduces ambiguity. Conversely, the low regime imposes harder reasoning demands as the solution space expands beyond the training distribution. Here we find evidence of how relational abstractions capture the underlying task rules rather than just imitating pixel-wise distributions, and show that disentanglement with k = 16 k=16 strongly aids out-of-distribution generalization in contrast to k = 121 k=121 , which slightly overfits the training set. While Base model plummets (in-distribution (Table 1 ): 80.04 → \to low : 39.48), RDM clue with 16 slots maintains consistency (in-distribution: 82.06 → \to low : 72.48).
paragraphs.zh: Akari 实验结果：在所有分布场景下，RDM 始终优于基线模型，并在最具挑战性的（低）场景下展现出更出色的泛化能力。 在分布内（ID）评估中，RDM 使用 121 个槽位时准确率达到 83.12%，而标准扩散模型仅为 80.04%。 我们观察到 16 个槽位和 121 个槽位之间的性能差异（提示：83.12% vs 82.06%），这可能是因为槽位数量允许发现者自由学习槽位与单元格之间的双射映射，从而帮助推理器更有效地利用灯泡的放置方式。 在高场景下，所有模型都受益于更高的墙壁比例，因为它限制了解决方案空间、局部化了约束条件并减少了不确定性。 相反，低场景则提出了更复杂的推理要求，因为解决方案空间已超出训练分布的范围。 在此，我们发现了关系抽象如何捕捉任务底层规则而非仅仅模仿像素级分布的证据，并表明当 k = 16 时，解耦操作显著提升了分布外泛化能力，而 k = 121 则略微过拟合了训练集。 尽管基础模型的性能急剧下降（分布内（表 1）：80.04% → 低场景：39.48%），但使用 16 个槽位的 RDM 提示模型保持了稳定性（分布内：82.06% → 低场景：72.48%）。

sents.en: Results on Akari : RDM consistently outperforms baseline models across all distribution regimes and demonstrates superior generalization capabilities under the most challenging ( low ) regime.

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation of SRM reveals that diffusion forcing does not universally benefit grid-based puzzles. While SRM excels in MNIST-Sudoku ( Wewer et al., 2025 ) , where patch-based noise levels combined with uncertainty-based sampling align with optimal Sudoku-solving heuristics, its strategy fails to generalize to Akari , where reasoning variables are not evenly distributed across cells. During training, diffusion forcing yields a vast combinatorial space of noise levels that mostly affect illuminated cells, damaging convergence ( acc : 18.80). At inference, SRM sequential prematurely prioritizes denoising empty (yellow-illuminated) cells due to their persistent low uncertainty, resulting in performance collapse, where the critical task of bulb placement is deferred until the final sampling states.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 SRM 的评估表明，扩散强制并非总能对基于网格的谜题产生有益影响。 尽管 SRM 在 MNIST-Sudoku（Wewer 等人，2025）中表现优异——在该任务中，基于区块的噪声水平与基于不确定性的采样策略恰好符合解决数独的最佳启发式方法——但其策略却无法推广到 Akari，因为该任务的推理变量并未均匀分布在各个单元格中。 在训练阶段，扩散强制会产生一个庞大的组合式噪声空间，这些噪声主要影响已照亮的单元格，从而损害了收敛性（acc：18.80）。 在推理阶段，SRM 会因空单元格（黄色高亮）持续处于低不确定性状态而提前优先对其去噪，导致性能崩溃；此时，关键的灯泡放置任务被推迟到了最后的采样状态阶段。

paragraphs.en: Results on Coldoku : Our results from Table 1 show that RDM generally outperforms all baselines in color accuracy and overall accuracy at the easy and medium levels of Coldoku , and SRM performs better in the hard regime. The best performance was achieved with 16 slots ( acc : 97.48 easy , 71.64 medium and 12.58 hard ), whereas the full 81-slot configuration caused acc on the easy level to drop to 90.36. We hypothesize that the primary bottleneck in Coldoku is not the slot embeddings themselves, but rather the relational abstraction module ( ℛ \mathcal{R} ) shared between the clue and the solution as input with a high number of slots k = 81 k=81 , which requires the unique ℛ \mathcal{R} to reconcile complex positional and feature relations from two distinct distributions. Coldoku involves a diverse set of objects (multi-colored digits) in varying positions, while Akari presents a much smaller object vocabulary, where the complexity is exclusively positional.
paragraphs.zh: Coldoku 实验结果：表 1 的结果表明，在 Coldoku 的简单和中等难度下，RDM 在颜色准确率和总体准确率上普遍优于所有基线模型，而在高难度模式下，SRM 的表现更优。 使用 16 个槽位时取得了最佳性能（准确率：简单 97.48%，中等 71.64%，困难 12.58%），而使用全部 81 个槽位的配置则导致简单难度的准确率下降至 90.36%。 我们推测，Coldoku 的主要瓶颈并非槽位嵌入本身，而是线索与解决方案共享的关系抽象模块（ℛ \mathcal{R}）；当输入槽位数 k = 81 时，该模块需要处理来自两个不同分布的复杂位置关系和特征关系。 Coldoku 涉及多种多样的对象（多色数字）且位置各不相同，而 Akari 的对象词汇量要小得多，其复杂性完全体现在位置上。

sents.zh: 使用 16 个槽位时取得了最佳性能（准确率：简单 97.48%，中等 71.64%，困难 12.58%），而使用全部 81 个槽位的配置则导致简单难度的准确率下降至 90.36%。

sents.en: We hypothesize that the primary bottleneck in Coldoku is not the slot embeddings themselves, but rather the relational abstraction module ( ℛ \mathcal{R} ) shared between the clue and the solution as input with a high number of slots k = 81 k=81 , which requires the unique ℛ \mathcal{R} to reconcile complex positional and feature relations from two distinct distributions.
sents.zh: 我们推测，Coldoku 的主要瓶颈并非槽位嵌入本身，而是线索与解决方案共享的关系抽象模块（ℛ \mathcal{R}）；当输入槽位数 k = 81 时，该模块需要处理来自两个不同分布的复杂位置关系和特征关系。

sents.en: Coldoku involves a diverse set of objects (multi-colored digits) in varying positions, while Akari presents a much smaller object vocabulary, where the complexity is exclusively positional.
sents.zh: Coldoku 涉及多种多样的对象（多色数字）且位置各不相同，而 Akari 的对象词汇量要小得多，其复杂性完全体现在位置上。

paragraphs.en: Tildoku ( Tilted and Colored Sudoku) : We observed that SRM performs well on hard grid-based puzzles with sequential, cell-wise reasoning. However, its reliance on the grid’s geometry and patch structure introduces an implicit task-aligned bias. To challenge this in a more general scenario, we introduce Tildoku , where Coldoku images are randomly tilted (see § A.2 for details), disrupting the alignment between grid cells and image coordinates. Thus, the spatial structure now does not necessarily align with the grid-informed reasoning mechanism that SRM utilizes.
paragraphs.zh: Tildoku（倾斜彩色数独）：我们观察到，SRM 在需要按顺序对每个单元格进行推理的复杂网格谜题中表现良好。 然而，它对网格几何形状和图像块结构的依赖引入了一种隐性的任务相关偏差。 为了在更通用的场景下对此提出挑战，我们引入了 Tildoku：其中 Coldoku 图像会被随机倾斜（详见 § A.2），从而破坏网格单元格与图像坐标之间的对齐关系。 因此，空间结构不再必然与 SRM 所依赖的基于网格的推理机制保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 shows results on Tildoku ( Medium , τ = 10 \tau=10 ) for different displacement ratios at test time (left), and their average (right), where RDM demonstrates more robust reasoning ( acc : 28.40 averaged across various displacement ratios with the solution approach). Notably, SRM significantly worsens when increasing the tilting degree at inference time (orange line in the plot), resulting in lower average metrics. This is due to the fact that the learned uncertainty is only consistent when patches cover objects from a stable distribution (e.g., when each patch covers exactly one digit), and it becomes unstable when a patch covers half of a digit or none. Figure 6 (left) demonstrates this effect, where SRM outperforms the baseline at low tilting degrees, but abruptly collapses when digits do not align within fixed patches (see Table 8 for extended results).
paragraphs.zh: 图 6 展示了在测试阶段（左侧）不同位移比下 Tildoku（Medium，τ = 10 \tau=10）上的结果，以及它们的平均值（右侧），其中 RDM 表现出更稳健的推理能力（acc：采用该解决方案方法后，在各种位移比下的平均值为 28.40）。 值得注意的是，在推理阶段增加倾斜程度时，SRM 的性能会显著下降（图中橙色线），导致平均指标降低。 这是因为所学习的不确定性仅在图像块覆盖来自稳定分布的物体时（例如，每个图像块恰好覆盖一个数字）保持一致；而当图像块覆盖半个数字或完全不覆盖数字时，这种不确定性会变得不稳定。 图 6（左侧）展示了这一效应：在低倾斜程度下，SRM 的性能优于基线模型；但当数字无法在固定图像块内对齐时，其性能会突然崩溃（更多结果请参见表 8）。

paragraphs.en: Results on Tangram : Table 2 shows that RDM significantly surpasses baselines across all metrics on Tangram . Notably, RDM ( full ) reaches three times the baseline performance, achieving acc : 46.76, compared to baseline’s 15.46 (see Figure 18 for visual results). In contrast to Akari and Coldoku , we observe a considerable improvement when incorporating the solution into the abstractor stack ( clue : 34.37 → \to solution : 38.57 → \to full : 46.76). This behavior arises from how relational features differ between the clue and solution distributions. RDM ( clue ) only extracts primitives from the piece view (colors and size proportions), mainly boosting accuracy in color assignment (Base: 15.46 vs clue : 34.37), but maintaining the shape accuracy close to the baseline (Base: 57.72 vs clue : 58.41). Adding information from the solution view, which provides the explicit silhouette partition, boosts the shape and overall accuracy to 65.12 and 46.76 respectively, showing that the relational stack effectively captures the structural dependencies between these two views to guide reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: Tangram 实验结果：表 2 显示，RDM 在 Tangram 的所有指标上均显著优于基线模型。 值得注意的是，RDM（完整）的性能达到了基线的三倍，准确率（acc）为 46.76%，而基线仅为 15.46%（具体可视化结果参见图 18）。 与 Akari 和 Coldoku 不同，我们将解法整合到抽象器堆栈后，观察到了显著的性能提升（提示：34.37 → \to 解法：38.57 → \to 完整：46.76）。 这种现象源于提示分布和解法分布中关系特征的不同。 RDM（提示）仅从部件视图（颜色和尺寸比例）中提取原始特征，主要提升了颜色分配方面的准确率（基线：15.46% vs 提示：34.37%），但形状准确率与基线相差不大（基线：57.72% vs 提示：58.41%）。 加入来自解法视图的信息后，由于该视图提供了明确的轮廓划分，形状准确率和整体准确率分别提升至 65.12% 和 46.76%，这表明关系堆栈能有效捕捉这两个视图之间的结构依赖关系，从而指导推理过程。

paragraphs.en: Results on LogicFace : Our results in Table 2 show superior performance of RDM. In particular, clue-conditioned models achieve the highest accuracies ( clue : 74.74 and full : 60.76, see Figure 20 for generated solutions), whereas standard diffusion models perform poorly ( acc : 11.24). Unlike Akari , Coldoku and Tangram , where baselines remained competitive, LogicFace presents the unique challenge of simultaneously modeling a complex real-image distribution, encoding high-level features of multiple input arguments (e.g., gender, presence of glasses), and inferring logical operations to generate a consistent target image. Baseline models prioritize generating realistic human faces at the expense of satisfying the logical rules (see § C for image quality metrics), effectively ignoring any relationship between the inputs and targets. In contrast, RDM captures the underlying rules for all operators, as evidenced by accuracies that exceed trivial strategies, such as the model defaulting to a single mode (e.g., only generating a smiling female face).
paragraphs.zh: LogicFace 实验结果：表 2 中的结果展示了 RDM 的优越性能。 具体而言，线索条件模型实现了最高的准确率（clue：74.74，full：60.76，生成的解决方案参见图 20），而标准扩散模型的表现则较差（acc：11.24）。 与 Akari、Coldoku 和 Tangram 不同——在这些任务中基线模型仍具有竞争力——LogicFace 提出了一个独特的挑战：需要同时建模复杂的真实图像分布、编码多个输入参数的高级特征（例如性别、是否佩戴眼镜），并推断逻辑操作以生成一致的图像目标。 基线模型优先生成逼真的人脸，但牺牲了逻辑规则的满足性（图像质量指标参见 § C），实际上完全忽略了输入与目标之间的任何关系。 相比之下，RDM 能够捕捉所有算子的底层规则，这一点从其准确率超越了简单策略（例如模型默认仅生成单一模式，如只生成微笑的女性面孔）中得到了证实。

paragraphs.en: Impact of relational abstractions and evidence of rule learning: In an ablation study, we isolated the impact of relational abstractions by evaluating a slot-based diffusion guidance approach, i.e., p θ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c , 𝐬 1 : k c ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathbf{s}^{c}_{1:k}) at training and inference, similar to previously proposed slot-conditioned diffusion models ( Jiang et al., 2023 ) . Our results in Table 11 revealed that explicit relational abstractions are critical for complex reasoning, beyond purely slot-based diffusion guidance alone (see § C.2.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 关系抽象的影响与规则学习的证据：在一项消融研究中，我们通过评估一种基于槽位的扩散引导方法（即训练和推理阶段使用的 p θ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c , 𝐬 1 : k c ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathbf{s}^{c}_{1:k})），隔离了关系抽象的影响，该方法与先前提出的基于槽位的条件扩散模型（Jiang et al., 2023）类似。 表 11 中的结果表明，显式的关系抽象对于复杂推理至关重要，其作用超越了单纯依赖基于槽位的扩散引导（参见 § C.2.1）。

paragraphs.en: Finally, besides our rule-consistent image synthesis evaluations, we also investigated whether the relational abstraction module learns embeddings that capture the logical rules required for reasoning. Across controlled experiments, we found evidence that these embeddings (1) yield near-optimal solution-conditioned inference at test time, (2) can help improve reasoning without the raw clue image conditioning, and (3) remain linearly separable between valid versus rule-violating puzzles (see § C.2.1 for further details on our empirical evidence of rule learning experiments).
paragraphs.zh: 最后，除了我们遵循规则的图片合成评估之外，我们还研究了关系抽象模块是否学会了能够捕捉推理所需逻辑规则的嵌入表示。 在一系列受控实验中，我们发现证据表明这些嵌入表示：（1）在测试时能够产生接近最优的、以解决方案为条件的推理结果；（2）即使没有原始线索图片的条件输入，也能帮助提升推理能力；（3）在有效谜题与违反规则的谜题之间仍然保持线性可分（关于规则学习实验的经验性证据，详见 § C.2.1）。

paragraphs.en: We study a key limitation of image diffusion models regarding their emphasis on pixel-level fidelity in conditional data distribution modeling, which limits their ability to capture logical structures required for spatial reasoning. We introduce RDM as a novel framework that enhances diffusion models with unsupervised object-centric relational abstractions of the structural regularities in the training data. While RDM does not incorporate explicit symbolic computation modules, it leverages learned relational abstractions that move diffusion models toward more symbolic forms of reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了图像扩散模型的一个关键局限性：它们在条件数据分布建模中过于强调像素级的保真度，这限制了它们捕捉空间推理所需逻辑结构的能力。 我们提出了 RDM 这一全新框架，通过利用训练数据中结构规律性的无监督对象中心关系抽象，来增强扩散模型。 尽管 RDM 并未引入显式的符号计算模块，但它利用了学习到的关系抽象，使扩散模型向更具符号化的推理形式迈进。

sents.en: We study a key limitation of image diffusion models regarding their emphasis on pixel-level fidelity in conditional data distribution modeling, which limits their ability to capture logical structures required for spatial reasoning.
sents.zh: 我们研究了图像扩散模型的一个关键局限性：它们在条件数据分布建模中过于强调像素级的保真度，这限制了它们捕捉空间推理所需逻辑结构的能力。

sents.en: We introduce RDM as a novel framework that enhances diffusion models with unsupervised object-centric relational abstractions of the structural regularities in the training data.

sents.en: While RDM does not incorporate explicit symbolic computation modules, it leverages learned relational abstractions that move diffusion models toward more symbolic forms of reasoning.
sents.zh: 尽管 RDM 并未引入显式的符号计算模块，但它利用了学习到的关系抽象，使扩散模型向更具符号化的推理形式迈进。

paragraphs.en: We further present a large-scale spatial reasoning benchmark comprising diverse challenging tasks, on which our approach significantly improves reasoning-driven image generation capabilities. We show that harnessing abstractions from different task components (clues and solutions) enhances reasoning both when applied during training alone for diffusion guidance ( solution ), and when used jointly during training and inference ( clue and full ). Our work does not aim to position any single variant as the preferred recipe, but instead demonstrates how object-centric relational abstractions can guide generative spatial reasoning with a task-agnostic approach. Experiments on grid-based image completion tasks revealed that current task-informed uncertainty-driven inference-time reasoning approaches ( Wewer et al., 2025 ) do not reliably scale across diverse reasoning tasks, where the failure modes became more pronounced in Tildoku under distorted grid structures. Nevertheless, our method is in principle compatible with any additional sampling-time reasoning approach ( Wewer et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步提出了一项大规模的空间推理基准测试，其中包含多样化且富有挑战性的任务；在该基准测试中，我们的方法显著提升了基于推理的图像生成能力。 我们发现，利用不同任务组件（提示与解决方案）中提取的抽象表示能够增强推理能力：无论是仅在训练阶段用于扩散引导（解决方案），还是在训练与推理阶段联合使用（提示与完整方案），均能取得效果。 我们的工作并非旨在将任何单一变体确立为最佳方案，而是展示了以对象为中心的关联抽象表示如何通过一种不依赖具体任务的方法，指导生成式空间推理。 在基于网格的图像补全任务上的实验表明，当前基于任务信息、以不确定性驱动推理阶段的推理方法（Wewer et al., 2025）无法在不同推理任务中稳定扩展；尤其在 Tildoku 中，当网格结构发生扭曲时，其失效模式更为明显。 尽管如此，我们的方法在原则上与任何额外的采样阶段推理方法（Wewer et al., 2025）均兼容。

sents.en: We further present a large-scale spatial reasoning benchmark comprising diverse challenging tasks, on which our approach significantly improves reasoning-driven image generation capabilities.
sents.zh: 我们进一步提出了一项大规模的空间推理基准测试，其中包含多样化且富有挑战性的任务；在该基准测试中，我们的方法显著提升了基于推理的图像生成能力。

sents.en: We show that harnessing abstractions from different task components (clues and solutions) enhances reasoning both when applied during training alone for diffusion guidance ( solution ), and when used jointly during training and inference ( clue and full ).
sents.zh: 我们发现，利用不同任务组件（提示与解决方案）中提取的抽象表示能够增强推理能力：无论是仅在训练阶段用于扩散引导（解决方案），还是在训练与推理阶段联合使用（提示与完整方案），均能取得效果。

sents.en: Our work does not aim to position any single variant as the preferred recipe, but instead demonstrates how object-centric relational abstractions can guide generative spatial reasoning with a task-agnostic approach.
sents.zh: 我们的工作并非旨在将任何单一变体确立为最佳方案，而是展示了以对象为中心的关联抽象表示如何通过一种不依赖具体任务的方法，指导生成式空间推理。

sents.en: Nevertheless, our method is in principle compatible with any additional sampling-time reasoning approach ( Wewer et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 尽管如此，我们的方法在原则上与任何额外的采样阶段推理方法（Wewer et al., 2025）均兼容。

paragraphs.en: Limitations: Our approach relies on object discovery to extract relational patterns, utilizing neural architectures with inherently finite scalability. While these models might not scale to “in-the-wild” scenarios in unconstrained scenes with thousands of entities, we argue that it still remains aligned with the scope of human reasoning, where the number of objects is naturally bounded by cognitive constraints. Nevertheless, more powerful relational vision representations may enable better scalability in natural scenes, making open-world visual reasoning an important direction for future research. We also note that the neural-based automated evaluators used in our benchmarks may be prone to minor estimation errors due to their own performance. However, the comparisons presented remain fair and valid as the identical evaluation pipeline applied consistently for all models.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性：我们的方法依赖对象发现来提取关系模式，并使用了内在可扩展性有限的神经架构。 尽管这些模型可能无法扩展到包含数千个实体的无约束场景中的“真实世界”情境，但我们认为，它们仍然与人类推理的范围保持一致——在人类推理中，对象的数量天然受到认知能力的限制。 尽管如此，更强大的关系视觉表示或许能在自然场景中实现更好的可扩展性，这使得开放世界的视觉推理成为未来研究的重要方向。 我们还注意到，我们基准测试中使用的基于神经网络的自动评估器，可能因其自身性能而存在轻微的估算误差。 然而，由于所有模型都一致应用了相同的评估流程，因此所呈现的比较仍然是公平且有效的。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we provide a detailed description of our spatial reasoning datasets, and motivate their use for evaluating generative models on challenging visual tasks. Our primary goal in introducing this novel spatial reasoning benchmark is to move beyond simple pattern matching by requiring generative models to satisfy discrete geometric and logical reasoning constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们详细描述了我们的空间推理数据集，并阐述了为何使用这些数据集来评估生成模型在具有挑战性的视觉任务上的表现。 引入这一新颖的空间推理基准测试的主要目标，是要求生成模型满足离散的几何和逻辑推理约束，从而超越简单的模式匹配。

paragraphs.en: Akari (also known as Light Up ) is a binary-determination puzzle played on a rectangular grid of empty cells ( ) and walls ( ). The goal is to place light bulbs ( ) in empty cells such that every cell is illuminated ( ) while ensuring no pair of bulbs shine on one another, i.e., no two bulbs share a line of sight, horizontally or vertically, unobstructed by a wall. Walls act as obstacles to light and may serve as numbered cells . These cells are annotated with a digit from 0 to 4, indicating the exact number of bulbs that must be placed in the four adjacent (orthogonal) cells.
paragraphs.zh: Akari（也称为 Light Up）是一种二元判定谜题，在由空单元格（ ）和墙壁（ ）组成的矩形网格上进行。 目标是在空单元格中放置灯泡（ ），使每个单元格都被照亮（ ），同时确保没有任何两个灯泡相互照射，即任何两个灯泡之间在水平或垂直方向上都不能有未被墙壁阻挡的视线通路。 墙壁会阻挡光线，也可以作为带数字的单元格使用。 这些单元格上标注着从 0 到 4 的数字，表示必须在其四个相邻（正交）单元格中放置的灯泡的确切数量。

paragraphs.en: We generated a dataset of one million 11 × 11 11\times 11 Akari puzzles 4 4 4 Akari grids can be of arbitrary sizes, but most commonly 11 × 11 11\times 11 or 13 × 13 13\times 13 . We opted for 11 × 11 11\times 11 simply to balance the image resolution with our computational resources. . Our generation process follows a constraints-first approach. We first distributed walls across 20%–30% of the grid, then allocated bulbs according to the core rules of the puzzle, and finally converted 50% of the walls into clued cells by annotating them with the count of their adjacent bulbs, leaving the remaining walls unnumbered.
paragraphs.zh: 我们生成了一个包含一百万个 11×11 Akari 谜题的数据集。4×4 的 Akari 网格可以是任意大小，但最常见的尺寸是 11×11 或 13×13。 我们选择 11×11 的尺寸，只是为了在图像分辨率和计算资源之间取得平衡。 我们的生成过程遵循“先约束”的方法。 我们首先在网格的 20%–30% 区域分布墙壁，然后根据谜题的核心规则分配灯泡，最后将 50% 的墙壁转换为带提示的单元格，通过标注它们相邻灯泡的数量来实现，其余墙壁则保持无编号状态。

paragraphs.en: Akari properties: Akari is an NP-complete problem ( Sun et al., 2021 ) , a complexity derived from the interplay between line-of-sight constraints and numerical wall requirements. Without clued cells, the problem reduces to polynomial time. Solving typically involves local constraint satisfaction, such as prioritizing bulbs for high-value clues or identifying bottleneck empty cells that can only be illuminated by a single potential bulb placement.
paragraphs.zh: 阿卡里问题：阿卡里是一个NP完全问题（Sun等，2021），这一复杂性源于视线约束与墙体数量要求之间的相互作用。 如果没有提示格，该问题可简化为多项式时间问题。 解题通常涉及局部约束满足，例如优先选择能对应高价值提示的灯泡，或识别那些只能由单一潜在灯泡位置照亮的瓶颈空格。

paragraphs.en: From a generative perspective, ensuring a unique solution elevates the task to a higher-order complexity ( ∑ 2 P \smash{\sum_{2}^{P}} or ASP classes ( Çelik et al., 2009 ) ). Standard algorithms rely on backtracking solvers: a candidate grid is produced and iteratively modified with additional wall constraints if more than one solution is found. To better evaluate model novelty and rule abstraction, our dataset permits multiple valid arrangements, allowing novel solutions that may differ from training annotations.
paragraphs.zh: 从生成角度来看，确保解决方案的唯一性会将任务提升至更高阶的复杂性（∑ 2 P \smash{\sum_{2}^{P}} 或 ASP 类（Çelik 等人，2009））。 标准算法依赖回溯求解器：首先生成一个候选网格，如果找到多个解决方案，则通过添加额外的墙壁约束进行迭代修改。 为了更好地评估模型的新颖性和规则抽象能力，我们的数据集允许存在多种有效布局，从而支持可能与训练标注不同的创新解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation of Akari : We evaluate generated images with a deterministic pipeline that individually classifies each cell as a bulb ( ) or illuminated background ( ) via mean squared error against target patches. A sequential algorithm then verifies the arrangement against puzzle constraints. We use five metrics: (i) accuracy , requiring all constraints to be satisfied, (ii) bulb accuracy , a relaxed metric ignoring numbered wall constraints, (iii) unlit count , the count of unlit empty cells, (iv) distance , as the absolute error between a wall’s digit and its actual adjacent bulb count, and (v) overlap , as the count of bulbs sharing a line of sight.
paragraphs.zh: Akari 评估：我们通过一个确定性流程来评估生成的图像，该流程针对每个单元格分别进行分类，判断其是灯泡（ ）还是被照亮的背景（），分类依据是与目标区域之间的均方误差。 随后，一种顺序算法会验证该布局是否符合谜题的约束条件。 我们使用五个指标：(i) 准确率，要求所有约束条件都必须满足；(ii) 灯泡准确率，一个放宽的指标，忽略带编号的墙壁约束；(iii) 未点亮单元格数，即未点亮的空单元格数量；(iv) 距离，即墙壁上的数字与其实际相邻灯泡数量之间的绝对误差；以及 (v) 重叠，即共享视线的灯泡数量。

paragraphs.en: Sudoku is a combinatorial number-placement puzzle played on a 9 × 9 9\times 9 grid, which is further partitioned into nine 3 × 3 3\times 3 subgrids (also known as blocks or boxes ). In its classical formulation, the objective is to populate the grid with digits from 1 to 9 such that each row, column, and subgrid contains every digit exactly once. Various extensions of the puzzle have been proposed, ranging from larger grid dimensions to the addition of supplementary constraints. The complexity of solving Sudoku puzzles has been formally classified as NP-complete ( Yato and Seta, 2003 ) . While it has been mathematically proven that a minimum of 17 initial clues is necessary for a unique solution, human-solvable puzzles typically provide 20 to 35 fixed digits to guide the player through the remaining cells.
paragraphs.zh: 数独是一种组合数字放置谜题，在 9 × 9 的网格上进行游戏，该网格进一步划分为九个 3 × 3 的子网格（也称为区块或方格）。 在其经典形式中，目标是在网格中填入从 1 到 9 的数字，使得每行、每列和每个子网格都恰好包含每个数字一次。 人们已经提出了该谜题的各种扩展形式，包括更大的网格尺寸以及附加额外约束条件。 解决数独谜题的复杂性已被正式归类为 NP-完全问题（Yato 和 Seta，2003）。 尽管数学上已证明至少需要 17 个初始提示才能得出唯一解，但人类可解的数独通常提供 20 到 35 个固定数字，以引导玩家完成剩余单元格。

sents.en: Sudoku is a combinatorial number-placement puzzle played on a 9 × 9 9\times 9 grid, which is further partitioned into nine 3 × 3 3\times 3 subgrids (also known as blocks or boxes ).
sents.zh: 数独是一种组合数字放置谜题，在 9 × 9 的网格上进行游戏，该网格进一步划分为九个 3 × 3 的子网格（也称为区块或方格）。

sents.en: In its classical formulation, the objective is to populate the grid with digits from 1 to 9 such that each row, column, and subgrid contains every digit exactly once.
sents.zh: 在其经典形式中，目标是在网格中填入从 1 到 9 的数字，使得每行、每列和每个子网格都恰好包含每个数字一次。

sents.en: Various extensions of the puzzle have been proposed, ranging from larger grid dimensions to the addition of supplementary constraints.
sents.zh: 人们已经提出了该谜题的各种扩展形式，包括更大的网格尺寸以及附加额外约束条件。

sents.en: The complexity of solving Sudoku puzzles has been formally classified as NP-complete ( Yato and Seta, 2003 ) .
sents.zh: 解决数独谜题的复杂性已被正式归类为 NP-完全问题（Yato 和 Seta，2003）。

sents.en: While it has been mathematically proven that a minimum of 17 initial clues is necessary for a unique solution, human-solvable puzzles typically provide 20 to 35 fixed digits to guide the player through the remaining cells.
sents.zh: 尽管数学上已证明至少需要 17 个初始提示才能得出唯一解，但人类可解的数独通常提供 20 到 35 个固定数字，以引导玩家完成剩余单元格。

paragraphs.en: We introduce on a multi-constraint Sudoku variant that couples the classical digit-placement logic with a coloring challenge, named Coldoku . This task effectively requires the model to simultaneously solve a secondary Sudoku-style constraint involving nine distinct colors. We relied on the MNIST-Sudoku dataset released by Wewer et al. (2025) as our primary source for 1M solved Sudoku configurations. Following their methodology, we train an MNIST classifier to populate the grid cells with handwritten digits, thereby generating a realistic handwritten view of the Sudoku grid. To introduce the additional layer of complexity, we randomly pair each Sudoku with another independent Sudoku. The second Sudoku determines the color assignment for each digit, effectively creating a Coldoku puzzle where both digit and color placements must satisfy Sudoku constraints (Figure 3 ). Our dataset uses the Tableau 10 palette, which is designed to have a large perceptual difference between colors (blue ∙ \bullet , orange ∙ \bullet , green ∙ \bullet , red ∙ \bullet , purple ∙ \bullet , brown ∙ \bullet , pink ∙ \bullet , olive ∙ \bullet and cyan ∙ \bullet . By cross-combining these digit and color arrangements, the resulting dataset spans a massive state space of 10 12 10^{12} (1M 2 ) unique puzzle configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种多约束数独变体，它将经典的数字放置逻辑与填色挑战相结合，并将其命名为 Coldoku。这项任务实际上要求模型同时解决一个涉及九种不同颜色的次要数独式约束。我们将 Wewer 等人（2025）发布的 MNIST-Sudoku 数据集作为主要来源，获取了 100 万个已解出的数独配置。遵循其方法论，我们训练了一个 MNIST 分类器来用手写数字填充网格单元格，从而生成数独网格的逼真手写视图。为了引入额外的复杂层次，我们将每个数独与另一个独立的数独随机配对。第二个数独决定了每个数字的颜色分配，从而有效地创建了一个 Coldoku 谜题，其中数字和颜色的放置都必须满足数独约束（图 3）。我们的数据集使用了 Tableau 10 色板，该色板旨在使颜色之间具有较大的感知差异（蓝色 ∙ \bullet、橙色 ∙ \bullet、绿色 ∙ \bullet、红色 ∙ \bullet、紫色 ∙ \bullet、棕色 ∙ \bullet、粉色 ∙ \bullet、橄榄绿 ∙ \bullet 和青色 ∙ \bullet）。通过交叉组合这些数字和颜色排列，最终数据集涵盖了高达 10^{12}（即 1M²）个唯一谜题配置的庞大状态空间。

paragraphs.en: Coldoku properties: Coldoku inherits the formal logical properties of the classical Sudoku puzzle, as it effectively requires the joint resolution of two orthogonal Sudoku instances (one in the digit domain and one in the color domain) given the same set of initial clues. While a human solver would likely adopt a sequential strategy, first solving the digit arrangement before addressing the color-based constraints, a neural network must perform these operations as a simultaneous multi-objective task.
paragraphs.zh: Coldoku 的特性：Coldoku 继承了经典数独的正式逻辑特性，因为它实际上要求在给定相同初始线索的情况下，同时解决两个正交数独实例（一个在数字域中，另一个在颜色域中）。 虽然人类解题者可能会采用顺序策略，即先解决数字排列问题，再处理基于颜色的约束条件，但神经网络必须将这些操作作为同步的多目标任务来执行。

sents.en: Coldoku properties: Coldoku inherits the formal logical properties of the classical Sudoku puzzle, as it effectively requires the joint resolution of two orthogonal Sudoku instances (one in the digit domain and one in the color domain) given the same set of initial clues.
sents.zh: Coldoku 的特性：Coldoku 继承了经典数独的正式逻辑特性，因为它实际上要求在给定相同初始线索的情况下，同时解决两个正交数独实例（一个在数字域中，另一个在颜色域中）。

sents.en: While a human solver would likely adopt a sequential strategy, first solving the digit arrangement before addressing the color-based constraints, a neural network must perform these operations as a simultaneous multi-objective task.
sents.zh: 虽然人类解题者可能会采用顺序策略，即先解决数字排列问题，再处理基于颜色的约束条件，但神经网络必须将这些操作作为同步的多目标任务来执行。

paragraphs.en: The properties of uniqueness and complexity (NP-completeness) are preserved for both the digit and color layers. Consequently, Coldoku represents an inherently more challenging benchmark for generative models, as it requires the latent reasoning module to maintain two independent sets of global constraints and resolve them within a single inference pass.
paragraphs.zh: 唯一性和复杂性（NP-完全性）这两个特性在数字层和颜色层中均得以保留。 因此，Coldoku 对生成模型而言是一个本质上更具挑战性的基准测试，因为它要求潜在推理模块同时维护两组独立的全局约束，并在单次推理过程中解决它们。

sents.en: The properties of uniqueness and complexity (NP-completeness) are preserved for both the digit and color layers.
sents.zh: 唯一性和复杂性（NP-完全性）这两个特性在数字层和颜色层中均得以保留。

sents.en: Consequently, Coldoku represents an inherently more challenging benchmark for generative models, as it requires the latent reasoning module to maintain two independent sets of global constraints and resolve them within a single inference pass.
sents.zh: 因此，Coldoku 对生成模型而言是一个本质上更具挑战性的基准测试，因为它要求潜在推理模块同时维护两组独立的全局约束，并在单次推理过程中解决它们。

paragraphs.en: Tildoku ( Tilted and Colored Sudoku ): To evaluate RDM in a more realistic scenario, we introduce Tildoku , a variant of Coldoku where samples are randomly tilted within a bounded angular range (see Figure 9 ). While Tildoku maintains the underlying logical rules and reasoning complexity of Coldoku , it introduces a visual challenge: digit completion now requires the model to detect the boundaries of a varying puzzle geometry. To ensure the task remains approachable, we limited the tilting distortion to the 15% of corner displacements. During training, each Coldoku sample is subjected to a random tilt within these bounds before being processed by the model. For evaluation, the associated affine matrix is utilized to reverse the transformation, allowing the predicted output to be verified by the Coldoku evaluator.
paragraphs.zh: Tildoku（倾斜彩色数独）：为了在更真实的场景下评估 RDM，我们引入了 Tildoku，这是 Coldoku 的一种变体，其中样本会在一个有限的角度范围内随机倾斜（参见图 9）。 虽然 Tildoku 保留了 Coldoku 的底层逻辑规则和推理复杂度，但它也带来了一个视觉挑战：数字补全现在需要模型能够检测出不断变化的谜题几何形状的边界。 为确保该任务仍然具有可解性，我们将倾斜畸变限制在角落位移的 15% 以内。 在训练过程中，每个 Coldoku 样本都会在这些限制范围内经历一次随机倾斜，然后再由模型处理。 在评估时，会使用相关的仿射矩阵来逆转该变换，从而使得预测结果能够通过 Coldoku 评估器进行验证。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation of Coldoku : We assess the generative quality of Coldoku samples using a two-stage pipeline. First, we train a CNN classifier on 28 × 28 28\times 28 colored MNIST images ( > 99 % >99\% test accuracy). To ensure precise classification, these training images are quantized such that each digit contains only its target color centroid against a black background. During evaluation, each generated 9 × 9 9\times 9 grid is partitioned into 81 individual cells and processed by the classifier to identify the digit-color pairs. Consistent with Wewer et al. (2025) , we mitigate the impact of perception errors on our reasoning framework by constructing the input Coldoku views exclusively from correctly classified MNIST samples. Following the perception stage, we independently verify the row, column, and subgrid constraints for both the digit and color arrangements. We report three primary metrics: (i) digit accuracy , ratio of grids where the 81 predicted digits satisfy all Sudoku constraints, (ii) color accuracy , ratio of grids where the 81 predicted colors satisfy all Sudoku constraints, and (iii) accuracy , joint ratio of grids where both the digit and color arrangements are simultaneously valid.
paragraphs.zh: Coldoku 评估：我们使用一个两阶段流程来评估 Coldoku 样本的生成质量。首先，我们在 28 × 28 的彩色 MNIST 图像（测试准确率 >99%）上训练一个 CNN 分类器。为确保分类精确，这些训练图像经过量化处理，使得每个数字在黑色背景上仅包含其目标颜色的色心。在评估阶段，每个生成的 9 × 9 网格被划分为 81 个独立单元格，并由分类器处理以识别数字与颜色的对应关系。与 Wewer 等人（2025）的研究一致，我们通过仅使用正确分类的 MNIST 样本来构建输入 Coldoku 视图，从而减轻感知错误对我们推理框架的影响。在感知阶段之后，我们分别验证数字和颜色排列的行、列及子网格约束条件。我们报告三项主要指标：(i) 数字准确率，即 81 个预测数字均满足所有数独约束的网格比例；(ii) 颜色准确率，即 81 种预测颜色均满足所有数独约束的网格比例；以及 (iii) 综合准确率，即数字和颜色排列同时有效的网格联合比例。

paragraphs.en: Tangram is a classic dissection puzzle consisting of seven flat shapes, called tans , which must be arranged to form a specific target figure, or silhouette (see Figure 4b ). The seven pieces (Figure 4a ), comprising two large ( △ L × 2 \triangle^{L}\times 2 ), one medium ( △ M \triangle^{M} ) and two small ( △ S × 2 \triangle^{S}\times 2 ) right triangles, one square ( □ \square ), and one parallelogram ( ), remain constant across all puzzles. The core challenge of the Tangram task lies in the latent inference that is required to map these seven discrete pieces onto a silhouette, where individual piece boundaries are not visible. A valid solution must satisfy three primary constraints: (i) all seven tans must be used, (ii) no two pieces may overlap or occupy the same spatial coordinates, and (iii) the final arrangement must maintain the area and size proportions 5 5 5 All tans maintain strict area ratios relative to the smallest triangle: the medium triangle, square, and parallelogram has twice the area of a small triangle, while each large triangle has four times the area. of the provided layout. Many Tangram layouts exhibit high visual ambiguity, i.e., cases where internal boundaries are not easily identifiable, making them a rigorous test for visual reasoning and spatial reconstruction, even for human solvers (Figure 10 ).
paragraphs.zh: 七巧板是一种经典的分割谜题，由七个被称为“tans”的平面图形组成，必须将它们组合成一个特定的目标图形或轮廓（见图4b）。 这七块拼图（图4a）包括两个大直角三角形（△ L × 2 \triangle^{L}\times 2）、一个中等大小的直角三角形（△ M \triangle^{M}）、两个小直角三角形（△ S × 2 \triangle^{S}\times 2）、一个正方形（□ \square）和一个平行四边形（），在所有谜题中均保持不变。 七巧板任务的核心挑战在于需要完成一种潜在的推理，即将这七个独立的拼图块映射到一个轮廓上，而该轮廓中各个拼图块的边界是不可见的。 一个有效的解决方案必须满足三个主要约束条件：(i) 必须使用全部七个“tans”；(ii) 任何两块拼图块不得重叠或占据相同的空间坐标；(iii) 最终排列必须保持所提供布局的面积和尺寸比例。所有“tans”与最小三角形之间的面积比例严格固定：中等三角形、正方形和平行四边形的面积是小三角形的两倍，而每个大三角形的面积则是小三角形的四倍。 许多七巧板布局都具有高度的视觉模糊性，即内部边界不易识别的情况，这使得它们成为对视觉推理和空间重构能力的严格考验，即便是人类解题者也不例外（图10）。

paragraphs.en: We rely on the SVG annotations from the Kilogram dataset ( Zhang et al., 2021 ) , which provides 1,013 uncolored, unique Tangram solutions. Each sample consists of an SVG file containing precise polygon coordinates for the final silhouette. We extended this dataset by randomly creating 9,200 shuffles to use as input clue (Figure 4a ). To color the pieces and the solution, we randomly sample with replacement a pool of nine colors: red ∙ \bullet , green ∙ \bullet , blue ∙ \bullet , yellow ∙ \bullet , magenta ∙ \bullet , cyan ∙ \bullet , purple ∙ \bullet , orange ∙ \bullet and teal ∙ \bullet , and match the color of each piece of the shuffled view to a piece of the same type in the solution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们依赖 Kilogram 数据集（Zhang 等人，2021）提供的 SVG 标注信息，该数据集包含 1,013 个未上色的、独特的唐图解决方案。 每个样本都包含一个 SVG 文件，其中存储了最终轮廓的精确多边形坐标。 我们通过随机生成 9,200 种排列组合来扩展该数据集，用作输入线索（图 4a）。 为了对各个拼图块和解决方案进行上色，我们从九种颜色中采用有放回抽样法随机选取颜色：红色 ∙ \bullet、绿色 ∙ \bullet、蓝色 ∙ \bullet、黄色 ∙ \bullet、品红色 ∙ \bullet、青色 ∙ \bullet、紫色 ∙ \bullet、橙色 ∙ \bullet 和蓝绿色 ∙ \bullet，然后将排列视图中的每个拼图块的颜色与解决方案中相同类型的拼图块相匹配。

paragraphs.en: While the original Kilogram dataset was designed to evaluate the semantic associations between silhouettes and language, recent works have begun addressing the underlying spatial reasoning task ( Yamada et al., 2025 ; Zong and Tan, 2026 ) . However, existing approaches such as TANGAN ( Yamada et al., 2025 ) treat the problem as a standard generative task using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to segment a silhouette into pieces. Such methods may overlook the discrete constraints of the puzzle (e.g., that a specific set of seven pieces with fixed area ratios must be utilized), and ignore the actual reasoning on the piece proportions to simply recreate a shapes.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管原始的 Kilogram 数据集旨在评估轮廓与语言之间的语义关联，但近期的研究已开始关注其底层的空间推理任务（Yamada 等人，2025；Zong 和 Tan，2026）。 然而，现有的方法如 TANGAN（Yamada 等人，2025）将这一问题视为标准的生成任务，利用生成对抗网络（GANs）将轮廓分割成多个部分。 这类方法可能会忽视谜题的离散约束条件（例如，必须使用一组具有固定面积比例的特定七块拼图），并忽略对拼图比例的实际推理过程，而只是简单地重构出形状。

sents.en: While the original Kilogram dataset was designed to evaluate the semantic associations between silhouettes and language, recent works have begun addressing the underlying spatial reasoning task ( Yamada et al., 2025 ; Zong and Tan, 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 尽管原始的 Kilogram 数据集旨在评估轮廓与语言之间的语义关联，但近期的研究已开始关注其底层的空间推理任务（Yamada 等人，2025；Zong 和 Tan，2026）。

sents.en: However, existing approaches such as TANGAN ( Yamada et al., 2025 ) treat the problem as a standard generative task using Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) to segment a silhouette into pieces.
sents.zh: 然而，现有的方法如 TANGAN（Yamada 等人，2025）将这一问题视为标准的生成任务，利用生成对抗网络（GANs）将轮廓分割成多个部分。

sents.en: Such methods may overlook the discrete constraints of the puzzle (e.g., that a specific set of seven pieces with fixed area ratios must be utilized), and ignore the actual reasoning on the piece proportions to simply recreate a shapes.
sents.zh: 这类方法可能会忽视谜题的离散约束条件（例如，必须使用一组具有固定面积比例的特定七块拼图），并忽略对拼图比例的实际推理过程，而只是简单地重构出形状。

paragraphs.en: To bridge this gap and enforce an actual human-like reasoning process, we augment the dataset by assigning distinct colors to each of the seven tans. This modification requires the model to perform joint spatial and logical reasoning: it must not only partition the silhouette correctly but also match the specific geometry of each piece (e.g., the large triangle vs. the medium triangle) to its corresponding color and position. This ensures that the reasoner is explicitly accounting for the size relationships and global constraints of the puzzle rather than relying on local shape generation. Additionally, this initialization (Figure 4a - 4b ) also resembles how humans solve the Tangram puzzle: from a random view of separated tans (the shuffle ), reasoning over the color and proportions to fill the layout. Our perception is robust to different shuffles of the same seven pieces, as well as rotations of the silhouette.
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥合这一差距并强制执行真正类人的推理过程，我们通过为七个“tan”分别分配不同颜色来增强数据集。 这种修改要求模型进行空间与逻辑的联合推理：它不仅必须正确分割轮廓，还必须将每个部件的具体几何形状（例如，大三角形与小三角形）与其对应的颜色和位置相匹配。 这确保了推理过程明确考虑了谜题中的大小关系和全局约束，而不是依赖局部形状的生成。 此外，这种初始化方式（图 4a - 4b）也类似于人类解决“唐格勒姆”谜题的方法：从分离的“tan”的随机视角（即“洗牌”状态）出发，通过推理颜色和比例来填充布局。 我们的感知能力能够适应相同七个部件的不同“洗牌”顺序，以及轮廓的旋转变化。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation of Tangram : We use a deterministic evaluation pipeline to assess the correctness of the generated solutions with our diffusion models. First, we quantize the color space by mapping each pixel to the nearest of 10 predefined color centroids (9 tan colors plus the black background). We then leverage the input layout to define the ground-truth boundaries of the silhouette. If the pixel-level mismatch between the generated image and the ground-truth layout exceeds 5%, the sample is immediately assigned zero accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: Tangram 评估：我们使用一个确定性评估流程，通过扩散模型来评估所生成解决方案的正确性。 首先，我们通过将每个像素映射到 10 个预定义颜色质心（9 种棕色调加黑色背景）中最接近的一个，对颜色空间进行量化。 接着，我们利用输入布局来定义轮廓的真实边界。 如果生成图像与真实布局之间的像素级不匹配超过 5%，则该样本的准确率立即被设为零。

paragraphs.en: Shape accuracy (correctly-shaped): if the polygons maintain the correct area and proportions and the set of extracted shapes matches the original seven-tan composition.
paragraphs.zh: 形状准确性（形状正确）：如果多边形保持了正确的面积和比例，并且提取出的形状集合与原始的七形组合相匹配。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy (correctly-colored): building upon soft accuracy, if the color of each placed piece matches the identity of the corresponding tan provided in the input piece view.

paragraphs.en: We challenge our spatial reasoning framework to abstract real-image patterns, and introduce LogicFace as a structured logical puzzle where facial features must satisfy specific combinations based on logical operators. The LogicFace puzzle consists of three images, sorted in a row (Figure 5 ), where the first two are the arguments ( A A and B B ) and the third one is the answer ( S S ). Each image contains a clear centered human face, characterized with κ \kappa binary attributes, named as 𝒂 , 𝒃 , 𝒔 ∈ { 0 , 1 } κ \boldsymbol{a},\boldsymbol{b},\boldsymbol{s}\in\{0,1\}^{\kappa} for A A , B B and S S , respectively. For each attribute, the puzzle fixes an implicit logical operator f j : { 0 , 1 } × { 0 , 1 } → { 0 , 1 } f_{j}:\{0,1\}\times\{0,1\}\to\{0,1\} such that the statement f j ​ ( 𝒂 j , 𝒃 j ) = 𝒔 j f_{j}(\boldsymbol{a}_{j},\boldsymbol{b}_{j})=\boldsymbol{s}_{j} holds.
paragraphs.zh: 我们挑战我们的空间推理框架，使其能够抽象真实图像中的模式，并引入 LogicFace 作为一个结构化的逻辑谜题，其中面部特征必须根据逻辑运算符满足特定的组合。 LogicFace 谜题由三张图像组成，按顺序排列成一行（图5），其中前两张是论据（A A 和 B B），第三张是答案（S S）。 每张图像都包含一个清晰居中的面部，由 κ \kappa 个二进制属性描述，分别命名为 𝒂 , 𝒃 , 𝒔 ∈ { 0 , 1 } κ \boldsymbol{a},\boldsymbol{b},\boldsymbol{s}\in\{0,1\}^{\kappa}，对应于 A A 、 B B 和 S S 。 对于每个属性，该谜题定义了一个隐式的逻辑运算符 f j : { 0 , 1 } × { 0 , 1 } → { 0 , 1 } f_{j}:\{0,1\}\times\{0,1\}\to\{0,1\}，使得陈述 f j ​ ( 𝒂 j , 𝒃 j ) = 𝒔 j f_{j}(\boldsymbol{a}_{j},\boldsymbol{b}_{j})=\boldsymbol{s}_{j} 成立。

paragraphs.en: We used the face images and annotations from the CelebA-HQ dataset ( Lee et al., 2020 ) and selected κ = 4 \kappa=4 binary attributes: smiling , male , glasses and young to characterize each input image, with the OR , AND , XOR and IMPLIES logical operators. These attributes and operators were fixed for all images of the dataset. During training, the first and second panels are used as clues, while the last panel is corrupted to task the reasoner to learn how to generate facial attributes such that the logical operators hold.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了 CelebA-HQ 数据集（Lee 等人，2020）中的面部图像和标注，并选择了 κ = 4 \kappa=4 个二元属性：微笑、男性、戴眼镜和年轻，来描述每张输入图像，同时使用了 OR、AND、XOR 和 IMPLIES 这些逻辑运算符。 对于数据集中所有图像，这些属性和运算符都是固定的。 在训练过程中，第一和第二幅图被用作线索，而最后一幅图则经过损坏处理，以促使推理器学习如何生成面部属性，从而满足逻辑运算符的要求。

paragraphs.en: LogicFace statistics: We selected the attributes of the LogicFace puzzle after a manual examination of the CelebA annotations, where we found smiling , male , glasses and young to be less noisy than the other labels, as well as uncorrelated. Attributes like smiling (48.21%) and male (41.67%) are balanced, while glasses and young constitute the 6.5% and 77.36% of the CelebA-HQ dataset, respectively. To ensure a balanced number of LogicFace configurations, we first uniformly sample one million LogicFace configurations, and then select images whose attributes matched the specific statements. Note that with this process, the LogicFace dataset is not balanced in terms of images (indeed, faces with glasses are considerably repeated since they need to cover the missing ratio of the CelebA-HQ dataset to create statements of the XOR operator). However, since our purpose is to abstract on the combinations of glasses rather than the diversity of the generation, we opted to use data augmentation methods (e.g., horizontal flipping) to expand the variety of the samples, but acknowledging that our diffusion models might be recreating training set replicas, especially for unbalanced attributes like (not) young and glasses .
paragraphs.zh: LogicFace 统计数据：在对 CelebA 标注进行人工检查后，我们选择了 LogicFace 谜题的属性。我们发现“微笑”、“男性”、“戴眼镜”和“年轻”这些标签比其他标签噪声更少，且彼此之间没有相关性。 “微笑”（48.21%）和“男性”（41.67%）等属性分布均衡，而“戴眼镜”和“年轻”在 CelebA-HQ 数据集中分别占 6.5% 和 77.36%。 为确保 LogicFace 配置数量均衡，我们首先均匀采样了一百万种 LogicFace 配置，然后从中选择属性与特定陈述匹配的图片。 需要注意的是，通过这一流程，LogicFace 数据集在图片数量上并不均衡（事实上，“戴眼镜”的面孔被大量重复使用，因为需要覆盖 CelebA-HQ 数据集中缺失的比例，以生成 XOR 运算符的陈述）。 然而，由于我们的目标是抽象“戴眼镜”的组合，而非生成多样性，因此我们选择了数据增强方法（例如水平翻转）来扩大样本的多样性，但同时也意识到，我们的扩散模型可能会重新生成训练集中的副本，尤其是在“年轻”（或“非年轻”）和“戴眼镜”这类不均衡的属性上。

paragraphs.en: Our spatial reasoning framework is composed of two models: (i) the discoverer , which is independently trained to disentangle objects in the scene through slot attention, (ii) the reasoner , which is a diffusion model tasked to model the conditional distribution q ⁡ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c ) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c}) guided via relational embeddings learned by a relational abstraction module. In what follows, we describe each module in detail, as well as the specific hyper-parameters used to train them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的空间推理框架由两个模型组成：(i) 发现者，它通过槽注意力机制独立训练，以分离场景中的物体；(ii) 推理者，它是一个扩散模型，其任务是建模条件分布 q⁡(𝐱₀|𝐱c)，该分布由关系抽象模块学习的关系嵌入所引导。 接下来，我们将详细描述每个模块以及训练它们时使用的具体超参数。
