sents.zh: 我们的空间推理框架由两个模型组成：(i) 发现者，它通过槽注意力机制独立训练，以分离场景中的物体；(ii) 推理者，它是一个扩散模型，其任务是建模条件分布 q⁡(𝐱₀|𝐱c)，该分布由关系抽象模块学习的关系嵌入所引导。

sents.en: In what follows, we describe each module in detail, as well as the specific hyper-parameters used to train them.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们将详细描述每个模块以及训练它们时使用的具体超参数。

paragraphs.en: The discoverer follows a similar architecture to the one proposed by Locatello et al. (2020) .
paragraphs.zh: 发现者的架构与 Locatello 等人（2020）提出的架构类似。

paragraphs.en: The slot encoder ℰ : ℝ H × W × c → ( ℝ m × d , ℝ m × d ) \mathcal{E}:\mathbb{R}^{\texttt{H}\times\texttt{W}\times\texttt{c}}\to(\mathbb{R}^{m\times d},\mathbb{R}^{m\times d}) maps the input image to a set of hidden features 𝐟 1 : m ∈ ℝ m × d \mathbf{f}_{1:m}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times d} through convolutional layers, alongside positional embeddings 𝐩 1 : m ∈ ℝ m × d \mathbf{p}_{1:m}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times d} , where m = hw m=\texttt{hw} corresponds to the reduced spatial resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 槽位编码器 ℰ : ℝ H × W × c → ( ℝ m × d , ℝ m × d ) \mathcal{E}:\mathbb{R}^{\texttt{H}\times\texttt{W}\times\texttt{c}}\to(\mathbb{R}^{m\times d},\mathbb{R}^{m\times d}) 通过卷积层将输入图像映射为一组隐藏特征 𝐟 1 : m ∈ ℝ m × d \mathbf{f}_{1:m}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times d}，以及位置嵌入 𝐩 1 : m ∈ ℝ m × d \mathbf{p}_{1:m}\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times d}，其中 m = hw m=\texttt{hw} 对应于降低后的空间分辨率。

paragraphs.en: The slot attention module, 𝒮 : ( ℝ m × d , ℝ m × d ) → ℝ k × d \mathcal{S}:(\mathbb{R}^{m\times d},\mathbb{R}^{m\times d})\to\mathbb{R}^{k\times d} , uses the extracted features ( 𝐟 1 : m \mathbf{f}_{1:m} ) and positions ( 𝐩 1 : m \mathbf{p}_{1:m} ) from the encoder to compute the slot embeddings ( 𝐬 1 : k \mathbf{s}_{1:k} ). This process begins by initializing the slots as 𝐬 1 : k ∼ 𝒩 ( 0 , 𝐈 ) \mathbf{s}_{1:k}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\mathbf{I}) , and iteratively refining them over η = 3 \eta=3 iterations using a GRU conditioned on the input features and positions. The output is an updated set of slots 𝐬 1 : k \mathbf{s}_{1:k} , whose information is decoupled into object-specific features ( 𝐟 ~ 1 : k \tilde{\mathbf{f}}_{1:k} ) and positions ( 𝐩 ~ 1 : k \tilde{\mathbf{p}}_{1:k} ) by computing the dot product of 𝐟 1 : m \mathbf{f}_{1:m} and 𝐩 1 : m \mathbf{p}_{1:m} with the final attention matrix of the refinement, respectively. This is formally outlined in Algorithm 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 槽位注意力模块 𝒮 : ( ℝ m × d , ℝ m × d ) → ℝ k × d \mathcal{S}:(\mathbb{R}^{m\times d},\mathbb{R}^{m\times d})\to\mathbb{R}^{k\times d} 利用编码器中提取的特征 ( 𝐟 1 : m \mathbf{f}_{1:m} ) 和位置信息 ( 𝐩 1 : m \mathbf{p}_{1:m} ) 来计算槽位嵌入 ( 𝐬 1 : k \mathbf{s}_{1:k} )。 该过程首先将槽位初始化为 𝐬 1 : k ∼ 𝒩 ( 0 , 𝐈 ) \mathbf{s}_{1:k}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\mathbf{I}) ，然后通过以输入特征和位置信息为条件的 GRU，在 η = 3 \eta=3 次迭代中对其进行迭代优化。 输出是更新后的槽集 𝐬 1 : k \mathbf{s}_{1:k} ，其信息通过分别计算 𝐟 1 : m \mathbf{f}_{1:m} 和 𝐩 1 : m \mathbf{p}_{1:m} 与优化阶段最终注意力矩阵的点积，被解耦为对象特定的特征 ( 𝐟 ~ 1 : k \tilde{\mathbf{f}}_{1:k} ) 和位置信息 ( 𝐩 ~ 1 : k \tilde{\mathbf{p}}_{1:k} )。 该过程在算法 2 中有正式描述。

sents.en: The slot attention module, 𝒮 : ( ℝ m × d , ℝ m × d ) → ℝ k × d \mathcal{S}:(\mathbb{R}^{m\times d},\mathbb{R}^{m\times d})\to\mathbb{R}^{k\times d} , uses the extracted features ( 𝐟 1 : m \mathbf{f}_{1:m} ) and positions ( 𝐩 1 : m \mathbf{p}_{1:m} ) from the encoder to compute the slot embeddings ( 𝐬 1 : k \mathbf{s}_{1:k} ).

sents.zh: 该过程首先将槽位初始化为 𝐬 1 : k ∼ 𝒩 ( 0 , 𝐈 ) \mathbf{s}_{1:k}\sim\mathcal{N}(0,\mathbf{I}) ，然后通过以输入特征和位置信息为条件的 GRU，在 η = 3 \eta=3 次迭代中对其进行迭代优化。

sents.zh: 输出是更新后的槽集 𝐬 1 : k \mathbf{s}_{1:k} ，其信息通过分别计算 𝐟 1 : m \mathbf{f}_{1:m} 和 𝐩 1 : m \mathbf{p}_{1:m} 与优化阶段最终注意力矩阵的点积，被解耦为对象特定的特征 ( 𝐟 ~ 1 : k \tilde{\mathbf{f}}_{1:k} ) 和位置信息 ( 𝐩 ~ 1 : k \tilde{\mathbf{p}}_{1:k} )。

sents.en: This is formally outlined in Algorithm 2 .
sents.zh: 该过程在算法 2 中有正式描述。

paragraphs.en: The slot decoder 𝒟 : ℝ k × d → ℝ H × W × c \mathcal{D}:\mathbb{R}^{k\times d}\to\mathbb{R}^{\texttt{H}\times\texttt{W}\times\texttt{c}} is fed with the slot embeddings 𝐬 1 : k \mathbf{s}_{1:k} to generate individual reconstructions and their corresponding importance masks. The decoder spatially broadcasts each slot embedding onto a 2D grid, augmented with positional embeddings 𝐠 ∈ ℝ h × w × d \mathbf{g}\in\mathbb{R}^{\texttt{h}\times\texttt{w}\times d} . This is processed by convolutional layers to produce a candidate reconstruction per slot, named { 𝐱 ^ 1 : k } ∈ ℝ k × H × W × c \{\hat{\mathbf{x}}_{1:k}\}\in\mathbb{R}^{k\times\texttt{H}\times\texttt{W}\times\texttt{c}} , with an associated mask, 𝜶 i ∈ ℝ H × W \boldsymbol{\alpha}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{\texttt{H}\times\texttt{W}} . The final output 𝐱 ^ \hat{\mathbf{x}} is computed as the weighted sum of the candidate reconstructions, where the weights are determined by a softmax normalization over the masks: 𝐱 ^ = ∑ i = 1 k softmax ​ ( 𝜶 ) i ​ 𝐱 ^ i \smash{\hat{\mathbf{x}}=\sum_{i=1}^{k}\text{softmax}(\boldsymbol{\alpha})_{i}\hat{\mathbf{x}}_{i}} .
paragraphs.zh: 槽位解码器 𝒟 : ℝ k × d → ℝ H × W × c \mathcal{D}:\mathbb{R}^{k\times d}\to\mathbb{R}^{\texttt{H}\times\texttt{W}\times\texttt{c}} 接收槽位嵌入 𝐬 1 : k \mathbf{s}_{1:k}，以生成各个重建结果及其对应的重要性掩码。 解码器将每个槽位嵌入在空间上广播到二维网格中，并加入位置嵌入 𝐠 ∈ ℝ h × w × d \mathbf{g}\in\mathbb{R}^{\texttt{h}\times\texttt{w}\times d}。 卷积层处理该输入，为每个槽位生成一个候选重建结果，记为 { 𝐱 ^ 1 : k } ∈ ℝ k × H × W × c \{\hat{\mathbf{x}}_{1:k}\}\in\mathbb{R}^{k\times\texttt{H}\times\texttt{W}\times\texttt{c}}，并伴随一个掩码 𝜶 i ∈ ℝ H × W \boldsymbol{\alpha}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{\texttt{H}\times\texttt{W}}。 最终输出 𝐱 ^ \hat{\mathbf{x}} 通过候选重建结果的加权求和计算得出，其中权重由掩码的 softmax 归一化确定：𝐱 ^ = ∑ i = 1 k softmax ​ ( 𝜶 ) i ​ 𝐱 ^ i \smash{\hat{\mathbf{x}}=\sum_{i=1}^{k}\text{softmax}(\boldsymbol{\alpha})_{i}\hat{\mathbf{x}}_{i}}。

sents.en: The slot decoder 𝒟 : ℝ k × d → ℝ H × W × c \mathcal{D}:\mathbb{R}^{k\times d}\to\mathbb{R}^{\texttt{H}\times\texttt{W}\times\texttt{c}} is fed with the slot embeddings 𝐬 1 : k \mathbf{s}_{1:k} to generate individual reconstructions and their corresponding importance masks.

sents.zh: 最终输出 𝐱 ^ \hat{\mathbf{x}} 通过候选重建结果的加权求和计算得出，其中权重由掩码的 softmax 归一化确定：𝐱 ^ = ∑ i = 1 k softmax ​ ( 𝜶 ) i ​ 𝐱 ^ i \smash{\hat{\mathbf{x}}=\sum_{i=1}^{k}\text{softmax}(\boldsymbol{\alpha})_{i}\hat{\mathbf{x}}_{i}}。

paragraphs.en: The full architecture is trained end-to-end with the mean squared error between the original input 𝐱 {\mathbf{x}} and the final reconstruction 𝐱 ^ \hat{\mathbf{x}} .
paragraphs.zh: 整个架构采用端到端方式训练，其损失函数为原始输入 𝐱 {\mathbf{x}} 与最终重建结果 𝐱 ^ \hat{\mathbf{x}} 之间的均方误差。

paragraphs.en: Scalable decoder: To scale the number of slots k k to hundreds, we propose a scalable decoder that avoids the memory-intensive process of generating full candidate reconstructions for every slot. Instead, this decoder estimates the attention masks (alpha weights) prior to the broadcasting step.
paragraphs.zh: 可扩展解码器：为了将槽位数量 k 扩展到数百个，我们提出了一种可扩展的解码器，该解码器避免了为每个槽位生成完整的候选重建结果这一内存密集型过程。 相反，这种解码器在广播步骤之前先估计注意力掩码（阿尔法权重）。

sents.en: Scalable decoder: To scale the number of slots k k to hundreds, we propose a scalable decoder that avoids the memory-intensive process of generating full candidate reconstructions for every slot.
sents.zh: 可扩展解码器：为了将槽位数量 k 扩展到数百个，我们提出了一种可扩展的解码器，该解码器避免了为每个槽位生成完整的候选重建结果这一内存密集型过程。

sents.en: Instead, this decoder estimates the attention masks (alpha weights) prior to the broadcasting step.
sents.zh: 相反，这种解码器在广播步骤之前先估计注意力掩码（阿尔法权重）。

paragraphs.en: The mechanism uses a grid of positional embeddings, 𝐠 ∈ ℝ h × w × d \mathbf{g}\in\mathbb{R}^{\texttt{h}\times\texttt{w}\times d} . Unlike the standard decoder that broadcasts every slot to the full grid resolution, our approach computes the dot product between the grid and the slot embeddings 𝐬 1 : k \mathbf{s}_{1:k} to derive an estimated mask: 𝜶 ~ = softmax ( 𝐠 ⋅ 𝐬 1 : k ⊤ ) \smash{\tilde{\boldsymbol{\alpha}}=\text{softmax}(\mathbf{g}\cdot\mathbf{s}_{1:k}^{\top})} . The positional grid is then updated by aggregating the slots according to these weights: 𝐬 ~ = ∑ i = 1 ​ … ​ k 𝜶 i ~ ​ 𝐬 i \smash{\tilde{\mathbf{s}}=\sum_{i=1...k}\tilde{\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{i}}\mathbf{s}_{i}} . The weighted feature map 𝐬 ~ \tilde{\mathbf{s}} serves as the sole input for the subsequent decoder layers, effectively decoupling the reconstruction from the number of slots k k .
paragraphs.zh: 该机制使用一个位置嵌入网格，𝐠 ∈ ℝ h × w × d \mathbf{g}\in\mathbb{R}^{\texttt{h}\times\texttt{w}\times d}。 与标准解码器将每个槽广播到完整网格分辨率不同，我们的方法通过计算网格与槽嵌入 𝐬 1 : k \mathbf{s}_{1:k} 之间的点积来推导出一个估计掩码：𝜶 ~ = softmax ( 𝐠 ⋅ 𝐬 1 : k ⊤ ) \smash{\tilde{\boldsymbol{\alpha}}=\text{softmax}(\mathbf{g}\cdot\mathbf{s}_{1:k}^{\top})}。 然后，根据这些权重聚合各个槽来更新位置网格：𝐬 ~ = ∑ i = 1 ​ … ​ k 𝜶 i ~ ​ 𝐬 i \smash{\tilde{\mathbf{s}}=\sum_{i=1...k}\tilde{\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{i}}\mathbf{s}_{i}}。 加权特征图 𝐬 ~ \tilde{\mathbf{s}} 作为后续解码器层的唯一输入，从而有效地将重建过程与槽的数量 k k 解耦。

sents.zh: 该机制使用一个位置嵌入网格，𝐠 ∈ ℝ h × w × d \mathbf{g}\in\mathbb{R}^{\texttt{h}\times\texttt{w}\times d}。

sents.zh: 然后，根据这些权重聚合各个槽来更新位置网格：𝐬 ~ = ∑ i = 1 ​ … ​ k 𝜶 i ~ ​ 𝐬 i \smash{\tilde{\mathbf{s}}=\sum_{i=1...k}\tilde{\boldsymbol{\alpha}_{i}}\mathbf{s}_{i}}。

sents.en: The weighted feature map 𝐬 ~ \tilde{\mathbf{s}} serves as the sole input for the subsequent decoder layers, effectively decoupling the reconstruction from the number of slots k k .
sents.zh: 加权特征图 𝐬 ~ \tilde{\mathbf{s}} 作为后续解码器层的唯一输入，从而有效地将重建过程与槽的数量 k k 解耦。

paragraphs.en: Training details: We trained our Discoverer module with AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) , learning rate of 4 × 10 − 4 4\times 10^{-4} , batch size of 64, and linear warmup of 10,000 steps followed by exponential decay; using mixed precision (bfloat) for accelerated training.
paragraphs.zh: 训练细节：我们使用 AdamW（Loshchilov 和 Hutter，2019）对我们的 Discoverer 模块进行了训练，学习率为 4 × 10⁻⁴，批量大小为 64，采用 10,000 步的线性预热，随后进行指数衰减；同时使用混合精度（bfloat）以加速训练。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation: We assess disentanglement of the Discoverer by manually inspecting predicted samples, and additionally measure the reconstruction performance 6 6 6 Note that this accuracy is not correlated with the final reasoning accuracy since it only measures the pixel-level reconstruction quality of the autoencoder. In some cases, like Tangram , the accuracy is low since most of the shapes are not sharply reconstructed, causing the evaluator to not properly estimate the polygons. with the task-specific evaluators. For Akari , Coldoku , Tildoku and MNIST-Sudoku we use the cell accuracy (ratio of cells with matched predictions with the evaluator). For Tangram , LogicFace and Counting Polygons we run the evaluator on the reconstructed image and measure if the output satisfies the logical constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 评估：我们通过手动检查预测样本来评估 Discoverer 的解耦能力，并额外使用任务特定的评估器测量其重建性能。6 6 6 请注意，该准确率与最终推理准确率无关，因为它仅衡量自编码器的像素级重建质量。 在某些情况下（如 Tangram），由于大多数形状未能被清晰重建，导致评估器无法正确估算多边形，因此准确率较低。 对于 Akari、Coldoku、Tildoku 和 MNIST-Sudoku，我们使用单元格准确率（即与评估器预测结果匹配的单元格比例）。 对于 Tangram、LogicFace 和 Counting Polygons，我们在重建图像上运行评估器，并测量输出是否满足逻辑约束。

paragraphs.en: The relational abstraction module is designed to enrich slot representations with decoupled positional and relational information via attention mechanisms. It leverages Slot Abstractors ( Mondal et al., 2024 ) to map object-level information onto learnable relational embeddings . These embeddings are iteratively refined alongside the slots to produce high-level, position-aware representations.
paragraphs.zh: 关系抽象模块旨在通过注意力机制，将解耦的位置信息和关系信息融入槽位表示中，从而丰富其内容。 该模块利用槽位抽象器（Mondal 等人，2024），将对象层级的信息映射到可学习的关系嵌入上。 这些嵌入会与槽位一同进行迭代优化，最终生成具有位置感知能力的高层次表示。

sents.en: The relational abstraction module is designed to enrich slot representations with decoupled positional and relational information via attention mechanisms.
sents.zh: 关系抽象模块旨在通过注意力机制，将解耦的位置信息和关系信息融入槽位表示中，从而丰富其内容。

sents.en: It leverages Slot Abstractors ( Mondal et al., 2024 ) to map object-level information onto learnable relational embeddings .
sents.zh: 该模块利用槽位抽象器（Mondal 等人，2024），将对象层级的信息映射到可学习的关系嵌入上。

sents.en: These embeddings are iteratively refined alongside the slots to produce high-level, position-aware representations.
sents.zh: 这些嵌入会与槽位一同进行迭代优化，最终生成具有位置感知能力的高层次表示。

paragraphs.en: The relational abstraction module, ℛ : ( ℝ K × d , ℝ K × d ) → ℝ K × d \mathcal{R}:(\mathbb{R}^{K\times d},\mathbb{R}^{K\times d})\to\mathbb{R}^{K\times d} , builds upon the output of the slot autoencoder. As described in § B.1 , the slots from the encoder ℰ \mathcal{E} can be decoupled into object-specific features ( 𝐟 ~ 1 : k \tilde{\mathbf{f}}_{1:k} ) and positional embeddings ( 𝐩 ~ 1 : k \tilde{\mathbf{p}}_{1:k} ), which together compose the conditional latents for the diffusion model 𝐳 ∗ = ( 𝐟 ~ 1 : k ∗ , 𝐩 ~ 1 : k ∗ ) \mathbf{z}^{*}=(\tilde{\mathbf{f}}^{*}_{1:k},\tilde{\mathbf{p}}^{*}_{1:k}) , where ∗ = ( 0 , c ) *=(0,c) . This operation re-projects the consolidated slot information back into separate features and position subspaces.

paragraphs.en: The slot abstractor module (Algorithm 3 ) learns relational information between slots by passing their feature and positional information through L L abstractor layers ( Mondal et al., 2024 ) , consisting of interleaved cross-attention, self-attention and MLP blocks with residual connections. Through consecutive layers, the positional embeddings ( 𝐩 ~ ∗ 1 : k \tilde{\mathbf{p}}^{*}_{1:k} ) are updated by hierarchically pooling feature relations ( 𝐟 ~ ∗ 1 : k \tilde{\mathbf{f}}^{*}_{1:k} ), enabling the model to capture interactions between the discovered objects and learn contextualized positional-aware representations of their spatial dependencies.
paragraphs.zh: 槽位抽象模块（算法 3）通过将槽位的特征信息和位置信息传递经过 L L 个抽象层（Mondal et al., 2024），学习槽位之间的关联信息；这些抽象层由交替使用的交叉注意力、自注意力和带有残差连接的 MLP 块组成。 通过连续的层，位置嵌入（𝐩 ~ ∗ 1 : k \tilde{\mathbf{p}}^{*}_{1:k}）通过对特征关系（𝐟 ~ ∗ 1 : k \tilde{\mathbf{f}}^{*}_{1:k}）进行分层池化而更新，使模型能够捕捉已发现对象之间的相互作用，并学习其空间依赖关系的上下文感知位置表示。

paragraphs.en: We define the reasoning task as modeling the conditional distribution q ⁡ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c ) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c}) , where 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} is a valid solution for the reasoning task and 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c} is the initial clue or statement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将推理任务定义为对条件分布 q ⁡ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c ) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c}) 的建模，其中 𝐱 0 \mathbf{x}_{0} 是推理任务的一个有效解，而 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c} 是初始线索或陈述。

paragraphs.en: The reasoner is a diffusion model that simultaneously learns two distributions: (i) the unguided conditional distribution q ⁡ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c , ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 c ) ) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c})) , and (ii) the solution-guided conditional distribution q ⁡ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c , ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 c , 𝐳 0 ) ) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c},\mathbf{z}^{0})) , where the latent variables 𝐳 c \mathbf{z}^{c} and 𝐳 0 \mathbf{z}^{0} correspond to the feature-position embeddings obtained with the discoverer module. Since the goal is to model q ⁡ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c ) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c}) at inference time, ancestral sampling on 𝐳 0 \mathbf{z}^{0} is not possible, so the unguided distribution is the one sampled to generate a solution from the clue 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c} and the latents 𝐳 c \mathbf{z}^{c} .
paragraphs.zh: 推理器是一种扩散模型，它同时学习两种分布：(i) 无引导的条件分布 q⁡(𝐱₀|𝐱c,ℛ⁡(𝐳c)) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c}))，以及 (ii) 以解为引导的条件分布 q⁡(𝐱₀|𝐱c,ℛ⁡(𝐳c,𝐳₀)) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c},\mathbf{z}^{0}))，其中潜在变量 𝐳c \mathbf{z}^{c} 和 𝐳₀ \mathbf{z}^{0} 对应于通过发现器模块获得的特征位置嵌入。 由于推理阶段的目标是建模 q⁡(𝐱₀|𝐱c) q(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c})，因此无法对 𝐳₀ \mathbf{z}^{0} 进行祖先采样，所以通过从线索 𝐱c \mathbf{x}_{c} 和潜在变量 𝐳c \mathbf{z}^{c} 中采样无引导分布来生成解。

paragraphs.en: Architecture details: Our denoiser module uses a standard attention-based U-Net ( Ronneberger et al., 2015 ) comprising residual convolutional blocks where input images are always stacked in the channel dimension. Self-attention is applied to the visual features exclusively within the final two blocks of the encoder. Each residual block is composed of two 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolutions followed by a 2-factor pooling. The U-Net self-attention layers incorporate an extra cross-attention layer with shared KV projections to integrate the relational embeddings with the hidden features. Skip connections are implemented via channel concatenations between the corresponding encoder and decoder layers.
paragraphs.zh: 架构细节：我们的去噪模块采用标准的注意力机制 U-Net（Ronneberger 等人，2015），由残差卷积块组成，其中输入图像始终在通道维度上堆叠。 自注意力仅应用于编码器最后两个模块中的视觉特征。 每个残差块由两个 3×3 的卷积操作和一个 2 倍因子池化操作组成。 U-Net 的自注意力层包含一个额外的交叉注意力层，通过共享的 KV 投影将关系嵌入与隐藏特征进行整合。 跳跃连接通过在编码器与解码器的对应层之间进行通道拼接来实现。

paragraphs.en: In preliminary experiments, we also explored the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) architecture ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) as a backbone for the reasoning mechanism. However, it proved difficult to optimize this architecture even under baseline configurations for these specific spatial tasks. This observation also aligns with findings by Wewer et al. (2025) , who noted similar challenges in reasoning-heavy domains. We leave the development of hybrid architectures, leveraging the inductive biases of convolutional layers alongside the scalability of high-complexity Transformers, for future work.
paragraphs.zh: 在初步实验中，我们还探索了扩散变换器（DiT）架构（Peebles 和 Xie，2023），将其用作推理机制的骨干网络。 然而，即使在这些特定的空间任务中采用基线配置，优化该架构也被证明是困难的。 这一观察结果也与 Wewer 等人（2025）的发现一致。 他们指出，在推理密集型领域中也存在类似挑战。 我们将开发混合架构的工作留待未来研究，这种架构将结合卷积层的归纳偏置与高复杂度变换器的可扩展性。

paragraphs.en: Training details: We use AdamW optimizer ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) , learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , linear warm-up of 5,000 steps, and batch size of 128. For accelerated training, all denoisers are trained with the mixed precision (bfloat16). We train all models on the same number of steps.

sents.zh: 为了加速训练，所有去噪器均使用混合精度（bfloat16）进行训练。

sents.en: We train all models on the same number of steps.
sents.zh: 我们在相同的步数下训练所有模型。

paragraphs.en: We provide three size configurations for RDM to broadly investigate the impact of training small to large diffusion models for spatial reasoning tasks. Previous work like SRM ( Wewer et al., 2025 ) rely on large U-Net backbones (120M parameters) for puzzles like Sudoku, while others ( Goren et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) provide empirical evidence that visual reasoning can still be unlocked with small architectures ( < < 50M parameters). We show two key findings through our experiments: (1) RDM is compatible with multiple backbone sizes, scaling from 30M to 120M parameters, and (2) larger architectures do not necessarily benefit reasoning and smaller architectures are preferable for faster convergence. We highlight these findings as a positive result for the AI community in terms of reproducibility and feasibility.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为 RDM 提供了三种尺寸配置，以便广泛研究从小到大的扩散模型在空间推理任务中的训练影响。 先前的工作（如 SRM (Wewer et al., 2025)）依赖大型 U-Net 主干网络（1.2 亿个参数）来解决数独等谜题，而其他研究（Goren et al., 2026; Lee et al., 2025）则提供了经验证据，表明即使使用小型架构（<5000 万个参数），视觉推理能力仍然可以被激发。 通过我们的实验，我们发现了两个关键结论：(1) RDM 与多种尺寸的主干网络兼容，参数规模可从 3000 万扩展至 1.2 亿；(2) 更大的架构并不一定有助于推理，而较小的架构则更有利于更快的收敛。 我们认为这些发现对于人工智能社区而言，在可重复性和可行性方面具有积极意义。

paragraphs.en: We set RDM and capacity-matched baselines to three size configurations: small ( S ), medium ( M ) and large ( L ). In both S and M , RDM maintains a compact discoverer module of < < 8M parameters (see Table 5 ) while the reasoner leverages 25M and 40M parameters, respectively (see Table 6 ). In the L setting, we expanded the discoverer dimension to d = 512 d=512 to study the impact of richer slot embeddings, and matched the diffusion backbone in L to exactly mirror the model from ( Wewer et al., 2025 ) . Due to the computational overhead, we adapted the training limit to each task (see Table 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 RDM 和容量匹配的基线模型设置为三种规模配置：小型（S）、中型（M）和大型（L）。 在 S 和 M 两种配置中，RDM 保持一个紧凑的发现模块，参数数量远小于 8M（见表 5），而推理器分别使用 25M 和 40M 参数（见表 6）。 在 L 配置中，我们将发现模块的维度扩展至 d = 512，以研究更丰富的槽位嵌入所带来的影响，并使 L 中的扩散主干模型完全复刻（Wewer et al., 2025）中的模型。 由于计算开销较大，我们针对每个任务调整了训练上限（见表 6）。

paragraphs.en: The reconstruction quality of the discoverer module is evaluated with the cell accuracy in the grid-like puzzles ( Akari and Coldoku ). For Tangram , the evaluation pipeline described in § A.3 is also used to evaluate the discoverer. For LogicFace , we use the ResNet-18 classifier (§ A.4 ) on the reconstructed samples to match the real binary vector with the one predicted by the classifier.
paragraphs.zh: 发现模块的重建质量通过网格类谜题（Akari 和 Coldoku）中的单元格准确率进行评估。 对于 Tangram，同样使用 § A.3 中描述的评估流程来评估发现模块。 对于 LogicFace，我们在重建样本上使用 ResNet-18 分类器（§ A.4），将真实的二进制向量与分类器预测的结果进行匹配。

paragraphs.en: In Akari reconstruction accuracies achieved 97% and 98% using 16 and 121 slots, respectively. For Coldoku , digit reconstruction accuracy reached 82.64% with 16 slots and 99.79% with 81 slots. However, color accuracy was significantly lower at 40.41% and 72.05%. We observed that the gap in color reconstruction correlates with observed blurriness in the outputs. Because the slot autoencoder uses a variational architecture with a simple convolutional decoder, it is prone to producing blurred digits with imprecise color values. Consequently, more errors occurred when reconstructed colors fell between two palette values, leading to misclassification by evaluator. We observed a similar behavior for Tangram , where the discoverer only achieved 57% of accuracy with our evaluation pipeline (§ A.3 ). In practice the model showed real disentanglement (Figure 14 ), although reconstruction struggled to define sharp borders for the figures, leading to errors when estimating polygons with the deterministic evaluator. For LogicFace , we evaluated the discoverer’s reconstructions and obtained 95% of accuracy in the selected features ( smiling , male , glasses and young ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 Akari 的重建任务中，使用 16 个和 121 个槽位时，准确率分别达到了 97% 和 98%。 对于 Coldoku，使用 16 个槽位时数字重建准确率达到 82.64%，而使用 81 个槽位时则达到 99.79%。 然而，颜色准确率明显较低，仅为 40.41% 和 72.05%。 我们观察到，颜色重建的差距与输出结果中观察到的模糊性相关。 由于槽位自编码器采用变分架构和简单的卷积解码器，因此容易生成颜色值不精确的模糊数字。 因此，当重建的颜色落在两个调色板值之间时，会出现更多错误，从而导致评估器误分类。 我们在 Tangram 中也观察到了类似行为：使用我们的评估流程（§ A.3），发现者仅达到了 57% 的准确率。 在实际应用中，模型表现出真正的解耦能力（图 14），尽管重建过程难以为图形定义清晰的边界，这在使用确定性评估器估算多边形时导致了错误。 对于 LogicFace，我们评估了发现者的重建结果，并在所选特征（微笑、男性、戴眼镜和年轻）中获得了 95% 的准确率。

paragraphs.en: Quality of object disentanglement: Figures 14 and 15 illustrate the decomposition performance of the trained slot autoencoders on the Tangram and LogicFace datasets. While Slot Attention is theoretically designed to ensure perfect object disentanglement, we observed that for Tangram , certain slots remained inactive while others encapsulated multiple tans. We hypothesize that because pieces vary in color and exhibit slight scale variances across samples, the slots may have fit specific chromatic patterns rather than individual geometric entities. Consequently, the model occasionally groups co-occurring tans into a single slot instead of maintaining a strictly one-to-one object correspondence.
paragraphs.zh: 对象解耦质量：图 14 和图 15 展示了训练好的槽自动编码器在 Tangram 和 LogicFace 数据集上的分解性能。 尽管 Slot Attention 在理论上被设计为能够确保完美的对象解耦，但我们观察到，在 Tangram 中，某些槽保持不活跃，而其他槽则封装了多个 tans。 我们推测，由于各片在颜色上存在差异，并且在不同样本中表现出轻微的尺度变化，这些槽可能匹配的是特定的色彩模式，而非独立的几何实体。 因此，该模型偶尔会将共同出现的 tans 归入单个槽中，而不是严格保持一对一的对象对应关系。

paragraphs.en: Slot visualizations for LogicFace (Figure 15 ) depicts the inherent difficulty of object disentanglement in real images. We observed that salient, well-defined features from the CelebA-HQ dataset—such as glasses, smiling, and facial hair, are consistently isolated within specific slot embeddings. Conversely, the remaining slots struggle to decouple diffuse attributes, including skin tone and hair textures, or to model the high-variance backgrounds. This suggests that while Slot Attention effectively identifies discrete semantic anchors, it faces challenges in partitioning continuous or highly irregular global structures into distinct object-centric representations. We still find slot embeddings beneficial for reasoning, since key features were already represented into slots (glasses and smiling), while the others could be associated with other attributes (e.g., beard with male , gray hair with not young ).
paragraphs.zh: LogicFace 的槽位可视化（图 15）展示了真实图像中物体解耦与分离的内在难度。 我们观察到，来自 CelebA-HQ 数据集的显著且定义明确特征——例如眼镜、微笑和面部毛发——能够被一致地隔离在特定的槽位嵌入中。 相反，其余槽位则难以解耦扩散性属性（包括肤色和毛发纹理），也难以对高变异的背景进行建模。 这表明，尽管 Slot Attention 能有效识别离散的语义锚点，但在将连续或高度不规则的全局结构划分为独立的以物体为中心的表达时仍面临挑战。 我们仍然发现槽位嵌入对推理有益，因为关键特征（如眼镜和微笑）已被表示为槽位，而其他特征则可关联到其他属性（例如，胡须与男性相关，灰发与“非年轻”相关）。

paragraphs.en: Discussion on Tangram complexity: The majority of existing generative modeling literature focuses on Sudoku-style reasoning constraints for diffusion models ( Wewer et al., 2025 ; Avdeyev et al., 2023 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) . These works typically frame the task as an inpainting problem, where the model learns to satisfy localized relational rules within a fixed coordinate system. In our Tangram benchmark, generating valid solutions represents a significantly more complex challenge with fewer precedents in deep learning. Prior work, such as TANGAN ( Yamada et al., 2025 ) , used adversarial networks to partition silhouettes into geometric components. However, our benchmark requires the model to go beyond structural partitioning, and requires simultaneously perform geometric induction, maintain color-consistency across dynamic pieces and infer latent spatial transformations to align tans with a target configuration. The low baseline accuracy reported in Table 2 clearly reflects this increased dimensionality.

paragraphs.en: We conducted preliminary experiments to better understand the complexity of Tangram . We designed two intermediate level benchmarks to isolate the challenges introduced in the main task (geometric partitioning and color consistency). The first level resembles the TANGAN approach ( Yamada et al., 2025 ) , where the model is tasked with generating a valid partition of a given silhouette. We evaluated both a standard convolutional autoencoder (AE) and our baseline diffusion model on this task, using the silhouette as the sole conditional input and using solutions where a unique color was always associate to the same tan. Under this setup, the AE achieved only 1.93% of accuracy, whereas the diffusion model reached 82%. These results show that while traditional reconstruction-based architectures struggle with geometric arrangements, diffusion models are highly capable of learning complex partitions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了初步实验，以更好地理解唐图（Tangram）的复杂性。 我们设计了两个中等难度的基准测试，以分离主任务中引入的挑战（几何分割和颜色一致性）。 第一级测试类似于 TANGAN 方法（Yamada 等人，2025），其中模型的任务是生成给定轮廓的有效分割。 我们在此任务上评估了标准卷积自编码器（AE）和我们的基线扩散模型，使用轮廓作为唯一的条件输入，并采用每个“tan”始终与唯一颜色关联的解决方案。 在这种设置下，AE 的准确率仅为 1.93%，而扩散模型则达到了 82%。 这些结果表明，尽管传统的基于重建的架构在处理几何排列时存在困难，但扩散模型能够高效地学习复杂的分割方式。

paragraphs.en: In our second level, we introduced the additional challenge of chromatic modeling. Here, the model is provided with the target silhouette alongside a fixed piece view of the tans, where only the colors vary across samples. The diffusion model is tasked with generating a valid partition of the silhouette, while matching the specific colors provided in the tan view. Here, the model only needs to learn the fixed proportions of the pieces and the mapping of their associated colors. We consider this level simpler than our Tangram task, since the tan view does not remain fixed across samples in our task.

paragraphs.en: Under this configuration, the diffusion model’s partitioning accuracy dropped to 54%, with a total accuracy of 52%. paragraphs.en: We present further experimental analyses by: (1) isolating the impact of relational abstractions via an ablation study where we evaluate the reasoning capabilities of purely slot-conditioned diffusion guidance, (2) investigating empirical evidence of symbolic rule learning by the relational abstractions module, and (3) evaluations on previous spatial reasoning benchmarks MNIST-Sudoku and Counting Polygons ( Wewer et al., 2025 ) for completeness.

paragraphs.en: Empirical evidence of rule learning: Beyond our general evaluations of reasoning performance based on rule-consistent image synthesis, we further explore whether the learned embeddings by the relational abstraction modules truly capture the logical rules required for reasoning. We investigate this aspect in three different experiments with RDM. In our first experiment, we perform sampling from p θ ​ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c , ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 0 ) ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{0})) with RDM ( solution , by enabling access to the relational solution embeddings at inference time. Under this setting, accuracy boosted to 93% in Tangram , and 95% in Coldoku ( hard ), evidencing that RDM learns to abstract representations to almost perfectly solve both puzzles. In the second experiment, we used the Tangram dataset and removed the raw visual clues 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c} while training RDM to model p θ ​ ( 𝐱 0 | ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 c ) ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c})) . This approach yielded acc : 37.55 by surpassing again the Base model (15.46), and showing that the relational abstractions alone are powerful enough to replace the clue itself and improve reasoning. In our third experiment, we conducted linear probing tests on Coldoku . We froze the abstractor stack and trained a linear classifier to distinguish the relational embeddings produced by 6,400 valid and 6,400 invalid puzzles, where invalid puzzles were artificially generated to violate Coldoku constraints. In the first setting, invalid puzzles were obtained by arranging the same digit in all columns. In the second setting, the digit arrangements were randomly shuffled across the grid. We trained simple linear classifiers on these high-dimensional ( k × d k\times d ) embeddings, and achieved 89.98% in the first setting, and 82.59% in the second setting. These results indicate that the learned relational representations encode information that makes valid versus rule-violating puzzles linearly separable. Altogether, we treat these results as additional evidence that learned relational representations encode meaningful logical rule information for reasoning, and justify their effectiveness when guiding diffusion models.
paragraphs.zh: 规则学习的实证证据：除了基于与规则一致的图片合成对推理性能进行一般性评估之外，我们还进一步探究了关系抽象模块所学到的嵌入是否真正捕捉到了推理所需的逻辑规则。 我们通过三种不同的 RDM 实验来研究这一方面。 在第一个实验中，我们通过 RDM（解决方案）从 p θ ​ ( 𝐱 0 | 𝐱 c , ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 0 ) ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathbf{x}_{c},\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{0})) 中进行采样，从而在推理时能够访问关系解决方案嵌入。 在这种设置下，Tangram 的准确率提升至 93%，Coldoku（困难模式）的准确率达到 95%，这表明 RDM 学会了抽象表示，几乎可以完美解决这两种谜题。 在第二个实验中，我们使用了 Tangram 数据集，并在训练 RDM 以建模 p θ ​ ( 𝐱 0 | ℛ ⁡ ( 𝐳 c ) ) p_{\theta}(\mathbf{x}_{0}|\mathcal{R}(\mathbf{z}^{c})) 时移除了原始视觉线索 𝐱 c \mathbf{x}_{c}。 这种方法使准确率达到了 37.55%，再次超过了基础模型（15.46%），并表明仅凭关系抽象就足以替代线索本身并提升推理能力。 在第三个实验中，我们对 Coldoku 进行了线性探测测试。 我们冻结了抽象器堆栈，并训练了一个线性分类器来区分由 6,400 个有效谜题和 6,400 个无效谜题生成的关系嵌入，其中无效谜题是人为生成以违反 Coldoku 约束的。 在第一种设置中，无效谜题是通过在所有列中排列相同的数字得到的。 在第二种设置中，数字的排列在整个网格中被随机打乱。 我们基于这些高维（ k × d k\times d ）嵌入训练了简单的线性分类器，并在第一种设置中取得了 89.98% 的准确率，在第二种设置中取得了 82.59% 的准确率。 这些结果表明，所学到的关系表示编码了信息，使得有效谜题和违反规则的谜题能够被线性分离。 总而言之，我们将这些结果视为进一步证据，证明所学到的关系表示编码了对推理有意义的逻辑规则信息，并证明了它们在指导扩散模型时的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we conducted additional ablations on MNIST-Sudoku to demonstrate the benefits of object-centric representations for diffusion guidance. We perform conditioning via non-object-centric visual features from DINOv2 ( Oquab and others, 2024 ) and ViT-MAE ( He et al., 2021 ) . Table 12 shows these representations do not lead to substantial improvements in either the medium or the hard regime. Overall, performance is still worse than the Base model and RDM, demonstrating that object-centric relational representations are superior to non-disentangled image features for reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们在 MNIST-Sudoku 数据集上进行了额外的消融实验，以展示以物体为中心的表达方式对扩散引导的益处。 我们通过 DINOv2（Oquab 等人，2024）和 ViT-MAE（He 等，2021）的非以物体为中心的视觉特征进行条件约束。 表 12 显示，这些表达方式在中难度或高难度场景下均未带来显著的性能提升。 总体而言，其性能仍低于 Base 模型和 RDM，这表明以物体为中心的关系性表达在推理任务中优于非解耦的图像特征。
